Eligibility Criteria

  • Disc Code 101 – Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 102 – Technician Apprentice (Electrical): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 103 – Technician Apprentice (Instrumentation): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 104 – Technician Apprentice (Civil): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Civil Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 105 – Technician Apprentice (Electrical & Electronics): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 106 – Technician Apprentice (Electronics): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 107 – Trade Apprentice (Fitter): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Fitter) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 108 – Trade Apprentice (Electrician): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Electrician) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 109 – Trade Apprentice (Electronics Mechanic): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Electronics Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 110 – Trade Apprentice (Instrument Mechanic): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Instrument Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 111 – Trade Apprentice (Machinist): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Machinist) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 112 – Graduate Apprentice (BA/B.Com/B.Sc/BBA): Regular full-time Graduate in any discipline with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 113 – Trade Apprentice – Data Entry Operator (Fresher): Class 12th (but below graduate) with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/Board.
  • Disc Code 114 – Trade Apprentice – Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Class 12th (but below graduate) plus Skill Certificate of 'Domestic Data Entry Operator' for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.
  • Qualification must be from a recognized University/Institute as a full-time regular course. Qualifications acquired through Part-time / Correspondence / Distance Learning mode are NOT ELIGIBLE.
  • For Graduate and Technician disciplines, qualification must be acquired between 01.04.2022 and 28.02.2026.
  • For Trade Apprentices (ITI/Data Entry Operator), qualification must be acquired between 01.04.2021 and 28.02.2026.
  • Candidates possessing higher qualifications such as B.E./B.Tech., MBA, MCA, CA, ICWA, LLB or equivalent are NOT ELIGIBLE.
  • Diploma holders under lateral entry scheme (Class XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year) are also eligible subject to prescribed percentage in aggregate of all semesters.
  • A candidate may undergo a maximum of two apprenticeship trainings, and the second training shall not be in the same trade.

  • PwBD candidates: Age relaxation of up to 10 years (up to 15 years for SC/ST PwBD; up to 13 years for OBC-NCL PwBD)
  • Cutoff/Reckoning date for age criteria: 28.02.2026

Application Fee

  • No Application Fee has been mentioned in the official notification.
  • Candidates apply through NAPS / NATS portals; any charges levied by the portal (if any) are not specified in this notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 11/03/2026
Opening of Online Application 11/03/2026 from 10:00 AM onwards
Last Date for Submission of Online Application 26/03/2026 up to 5:00 PM
Document Verification Date To be intimated on registered email ID / IOCL website
Cutoff / Reckoning Date (Age & Qualification) 28/02/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates must register successfully on NAPS/NATS portal and apply against the notification to be considered for the selection process.
  • There will be no written test or interview.
  • A merit list will be prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential prescribed qualification for the respective post.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification.
  • Shortlisted candidates must complete a Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test and be adjudged medically fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical format.
  • Candidates whose documents and Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Certificate are found in order shall be issued an Offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training.
  • Opportunities not filled through the initial shortlisting shall be filled by eligible candidates from the merit cum panel list for the same opportunity.

General Information / Instructions

  • Candidates must apply only for ONE discipline code. Applications for more than one discipline code will be summarily rejected.
  • Applicants must submit applications only against vacancies notified under the states of Western Region (Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, UT of Daman & Diu, UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli). Selection of training locations outside notified states will result in rejection.
  • Candidate profile on the portal must be 100% complete (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category, etc.).
  • The candidature of the applicant shall be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates and testimonials.
  • Any false or incorrect information furnished at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature and liability for criminal prosecution.
  • Candidates should maintain the same registered email ID and mobile number till completion of apprenticeship training.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats shall be considered subject to fulfilling standards applicable to General category candidates.
  • PwBD candidates are NOT eligible to apply for Discipline Codes 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110, 111.
  • Reservation will be applicable as per the prescribed percentage for the respective States/UT.
  • No. of seats indicated is tentative and may increase or decrease at the absolute discretion of management.
  • Upon completion of the Apprenticeship period, IOCL shall have NO obligation to offer employment, nor can an Apprentice claim the right for employment.
  • A minimum one-year gap between two apprenticeship trainings is required, provided the previous training is completed.
  • All future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on IOCL website: https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships.
  • For OBC-NCL category, candidates must submit a latest caste certificate not more than 12 months old from 28.02.2026 in the Proforma prescribed by Govt. of India.
  • Canvassing of any kind shall disqualify the candidate.

How to Apply

  • Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria must apply online only through the NAPS/NATS Portal.
  • For Trade Apprentice (ITI/Data Entry Operator): Register at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/ (NAPS)
  • For Technician Apprentice (Diploma) and Graduate Apprentice: Register at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php (NATS)
  • After registration, login to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using your User ID/Email ID and APPLY for apprenticeship openings using the following Establishment IDs of IOCL (Marketing Division) – Western Region:
    • NATS Establishment ID: WMHMCC000053
    • NAPS Establishment ID: E01172700332
  • Application window: 11.03.2026 (10:00 AM) to 26.03.2026 (5:00 PM).
  • No other means or mode of application will be accepted.

Selection Process

  • Candidates must register successfully on NAPS/NATS portal and apply against the notification to be considered for the selection process.

  • A merit list will be prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential prescribed qualification for the respective post.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification.
  • Shortlisted candidates must complete a Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test and be adjudged medically fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical format.
  • Candidates whose documents and Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Certificate are found in order shall be issued an Offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training.
  • Opportunities not filled through the initial shortlisting shall be filled by eligible candidates from the merit cum panel list for the same opportunity.

General Information / Instructions

  • Candidates must apply only for ONE discipline code. Applications for more than one discipline code will be summarily rejected.
  • Applicants must submit applications only against vacancies notified under the states of Western Region (Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, UT of Daman & Diu, UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli). Selection of training locations outside notified states will result in rejection.
  • Candidate profile on the portal must be 100% complete (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category, etc.).
  • The candidature of the applicant shall be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates and testimonials.
  • Any false or incorrect information furnished at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature and liability for criminal prosecution.
  • Candidates should maintain the same registered email ID and mobile number till completion of apprenticeship training.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats shall be considered subject to fulfilling standards applicable to General category candidates.
  • PwBD candidates are NOT eligible to apply for Discipline Codes 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110, 111.
  • Reservation will be applicable as per the prescribed percentage for the respective States/UT.
  • No. of seats indicated is tentative and may increase or decrease at the absolute discretion of management.
  • Upon completion of the Apprenticeship period, IOCL shall have NO obligation to offer employment, nor can an Apprentice claim the right for employment.
  • A minimum one-year gap between two apprenticeship trainings is required, provided the previous training is completed.
  • All future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on IOCL website: https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships.
  • For OBC-NCL category, candidates must submit a latest caste certificate not more than 12 months old from 28.02.2026 in the Proforma prescribed by Govt. of India.
  • Canvassing of any kind shall disqualify the candidate.

How to Apply

  • Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria must apply online only through the NAPS/NATS Portal.
  • For Trade Apprentice (ITI/Data Entry Operator): Register at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/ (NAPS)
  • For Technician Apprentice (Diploma) and Graduate Apprentice: Register at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php (NATS)
  • After registration, login to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using your User ID/Email ID and APPLY for apprenticeship openings using the following Establishment IDs of IOCL (Marketing Division) – Western Region:
    • NATS Establishment ID: WMHMCC000053
    • NAPS Establishment ID: E01172700332
  • Application window: 11.03.2026 (10:00 AM) to 26.03.2026 (5:00 PM).
  • No other means or mode of application will be accepted.
  • Ensure your profile is 100% complete with Personal Details, Educational Details, and Category before applying.
  • Before applying, keep ready: PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account details with Cheque Book (name printed), and scanned copies of Educational Qualification Certificates.

Punjab Police Constable Eligibility Criteria 2026

Nationality

The candidate should be a citizen of lndia, who has not obtained the citizenship/permanent residency/green card of any other country.

Physical Standards

Cadre Minimum Height (Male) Minimum Height (Female/Transgender)

Punjab Police Constable Educational Qualification 2026

  • Candidates must have passed 10+2 or equivalent from a recognized Education Board/University on or before 01 January 2026.

  • For Ex-Servicemen, the minimum educational qualification is Matriculation.

  • Mandatory Punjabi qualification: All candidates must have passed Matriculation examination with Punjabi as one of the compulsory or elective subjects or any equivalent examination in Punjabi language on or before 01 January 2026.

Punjab Police Constable Age Limit 2026

  • Minimum age: 18 years (as on 01 January 2026)

  • Ex-Servicemen (Punjab residents): Actual service period in Armed Forces deducted from age, resultant age should not exceed maximum limit by more than 3 years
  • Serving government employees: Upper age limit relaxed to 33 years

Punjab Police Constable Salary 2026

Selected candidates for the post of Police Constable will receive a pay scale of Rs. 19,900/- per month as per Punjab Government Notification No. FD-FP-10MISC/87/2020-2FP1 dated 29.12.2020 and Punjab Police (First Amendment) Rules, 2025. Punjab Police Constable Selection Process 2026

The Punjab Police Constable Recruitment 2026 selection process consists of three stages:

Stage-I: Computer Based Test (CBT)

The CBT comprises two papers:

Paper-I (100 marks, 2 hours duration)

Section Topics Number of Questions
General Awareness Constitution, Central & State Legislature, History, Geography, Culture & Economy of Punjab, Health & Nutrition, Current Affairs 35
Quantitative Aptitude and Numerical Skills Simplification, Average, Decimal & Fractions, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Profit & Loss, Simple Interest, Time & Work 20
Mental Ability & Logical Reasoning Number & Letter Series, Sequencing, Statements & Conclusions, Pattern Completion, Order & Ranking, Direction & Distances, Relationship Problems 20
English Language Skills Reading Comprehension, Punjabi to English Translation, Sentence rearrangement & correction, Error Spotting, Fill in the Blanks, Spelling Correction, Vocabulary 10
Punjabi Language Skills ਸ਼ੁੱਧ/ਅਸ਼ੁੱਧ, ਸਮਾਨਾਰਥਕ/ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਸ਼ਬਦ, ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਅਖਾਣ ਅਤੇ ਮੁਹਾਵਰੇ, ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਤੋਂ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਅਨੁਵਾਦ, etc. 10
Digital Literacy & Awareness Fundamentals of Computers, MS Office, Internet, Email Communication, Mobile Phones 05
Total   100

Paper-II (50 marks, 1 hour duration) – Mandatory Qualifying Paper

  • Punjabi Language test of Matriculation standard
  • Qualifying criteria: 50% marks (25 out of 50)
  • Note: Marks obtained in Paper-II will NOT be counted for merit calculation

Minimum Qualifying Marks (Paper-I after normalization):

  • SC/BC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen: 35%
  • Other categories: 40%

Important Points:

  • No negative marking
  • Normalization will be applied as CBT conducted in multiple shifts
  • Answer key will be published after exam; candidates can raise objections within 48 hours (Rs. 50 per objection)

Stage-II: Physical Screening Test (PST) & Physical Measurement Test (PMT)

Candidates qualifying Paper-I and Paper-II will be shortlisted for Stage-II based on merit.

Physical Screening Test (PST):

Candidate Category Physical Tests
Male (including Ex-servicemen below 35 years) • 1600 meters race in 6 min 30 sec (1 chance)
• Long Jump 3.80 meters (3 chances)
• High Jump 1.10 meters (3 chances)
Ex-Servicemen Male (above 35 years) • 1400 meters walk/run in 12 min (1 chance)
• 10 Full Squats within 3 minutes (1 chance)
Female/Transgender (including Ex-servicemen below 35 years) • 800 meters race in 4 min 30 sec (1 chance)
• Long Jump 3.00 meters (3 chances)
• High Jump 0.95 meters (3 chances)
Ex-Servicemen Female (above 35 years) • 800 meters run in 6 minutes (1 chance)

Physical Measurement Test (PMT):

  • Height measurement as per eligibility criteria mentioned above
  • Candidates not meeting minimum height will be disqualified

Note: Pregnant female candidates may request postponement of PST/PMT by submitting medical certificate from government hospital. One opportunity will be given within 6 months after delivery.

Stage-III: Document Scrutiny

Candidates qualifying Stage-II will be called for document verification. Required documents include:

  • Matriculation certificate (proof of age)
  • 10+2 or equivalent certificate
  • Punjabi qualification proof
  • Domicile certificate (for female candidates applying under General category)
  • Category certificate (SC/BC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen, etc.)
  • NOC (for serving government employees)
  • Photo identity proof (Aadhaar, Driving License, PAN, Voter ID, or Passport)

Note: Candidates unable to produce original documents will not be considered for selection.

Punjab Police Constable Apply Online 2026

  1. Visit the official recruitment portal https://iur.ls/punjabpolicerecruitment2026
  2. Click on "Punjab Police Constable Recruitment 2026" link under latest notifications
  3. Complete registration with basic details and generate login credentials
  4. Log in and fill the online application form with personal, educational, and cadre preference details

  7. Pay application fee online through available payment modes
  8. Submit the form and download/print the final submitted application for future reference
  9. Note your Registration ID and keep checking portal for updates

How to Apply for Punjab Police Constable Recruitment 2026

  • Applications must only be submitted in the online mode on https:///ur.ls/punjabpolicerecruitment2026.

  • Applicants are advised to read the instructions, as given on the Recruitment Portal, carefully, before filling-up the application form.

  • The applicants are advised to fill all details, including their correct and active email address and mobile number, in the online application.

  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances nor can the fee be held in reserve for any other examination or selection
  • Important: No fee exemption is available to OBC/EWS candidates and they are required to pay the full prescribed fee

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Notification Date 20/02/2026
Start Date of Online Application 20/02/2026
Last Date of Online Application 12/03/2026 (till 18:00 hours)

Written Exam Timing - Paper-I 10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon
Written Exam Timing - Paper-II 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM
e-Admit Card Download Date Last working day of preceding week of examination date
Physical Standards Tests / Physical Efficiency Tests After declaration of Written Exam result
Interview / Personality Test After PST/PET (for qualified candidates)
Medical Standards Tests After Interview / Personality Test

Selection Process

  • Stage 1: Written Examination (19th July, 2026)
    • Paper-I: General Ability and Intelligence - 250 Marks
      • Duration: 2 hours (10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon)
      • Type: Objective (Multiple Choice) Type questions
      • Medium: English as well as Hindi
      • Subjects: General Mental Ability (logical reasoning, quantitative aptitude, numerical ability, data interpretation), General Science, Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Polity & Economy, History of India, Indian & World Geography
      • There will be penalty (Negative Marking) for wrong answers: One third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for each wrong answer
    • Paper-II: General Studies, Essay and Comprehension - 200 Marks
      • Duration: 3 hours (2:00 PM to 5:00 PM)
      • Type: Conventional (Descriptive) Type
      • Part-A: Essay questions (80 Marks) - to be answered in long narrative form either in Hindi or English. Topics: modern Indian history especially freedom struggle, geography, polity and economy, security and human rights issues, analytical ability
      • Part-B: Comprehension, précis writing, other communications/language skills (120 Marks) - to be attempted in English only. Topics: Comprehension passages, précis writing, developing counter arguments, simple grammar and other language testing aspects
      • Candidates must write answers only in the medium allowed. No credit for answers written in other medium
    • There will be minimum qualifying marks separately in each Paper as may be fixed by the Commission
    • Paper-I will be evaluated first and Paper-II will be evaluated only for those who obtain minimum qualifying marks in Paper-I
  • Stage 2: Physical Standards Tests (PST) / Physical Efficiency Tests (PET)
    • Conducted for candidates qualified in Written Examination
    • Physical Standards Requirements:
      • Men: Height 165 cm, Chest 81 cm (unexpanded) with 5 cm minimum expansion, Weight 50 kg
      • Women: Height 157 cm, Weight 46 kg
      • Height and chest measurement will be measured correct to one decimal in centimeter
      • Weight should be as per height and age as per prescribed chart
    • Physical Efficiency Tests:
      • Men: 100 Meter Race in 16 Seconds, 800 Meter Race in 3 Min 45 Sec, Long Jump 3.5 Meters (3 Chances), Shot Put (7.26 Kg) 4.5 Meters (3 Chances)
      • Women: 100 Meter Race in 18 Seconds, 800 Meter Race in 4 Min 45 Sec, Long Jump 3.0 Meters (3 Chances)
    • Female candidates must submit self-declaration about pregnancy status before PST/PET
    • Conducted under supervision of Nodal Authority appointed by Ministry of Home Affairs
  • Stage 3: Interview / Personality Test
    • Only for candidates qualified in PST/PET
    • Marks: 150 Marks
    • Conducted by Union Public Service Commission
    • Candidates declared unqualified in PET will not be called for Interview
    • NCC 'B' or 'C' Certificate holders will be given consideration at Interview stage
  • Stage 4: Medical Standards Tests (MST)
    • Conducted only for candidates who appeared in Interview/Personality Test
    • Detailed Medical Standards prescribed for Eye Sight, Ear, Nose, Neck, Teeth, General Health, etc.
    • Eye Sight: Better eye 6/6 or 6/9 (corrected), Worse eye 6/12 or 6/9 (corrected), Near Vision N6/N9 (corrected), Colour Perception CP-III by ISIHARA plates
    • LASIK surgery correction permitted subject to prescribed criteria
    • Candidates declared 'UNFIT' can appear before Review Medical Board preferably next day of DME
    • Appeals against MST results must be made within 24 hours after declaration of DME results
    • Conducted under supervision of Nodal Authority appointed by Ministry of Home Affairs
  • Final Selection/Merit:
    • Merit list drawn on basis of marks obtained in Written Examination and Interview/Personality Test
    • Any candidate found not satisfying prescribed Medical Standards after MST will not be appointed
    • Tie Breaking Principle: (i) Higher marks in written total, (ii) Higher marks in Paper-I, (iii) Senior in age, (iv) At Commission's discretion

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply online only using the Commission's website: https://upsconline.nic.in
  • No other mode is allowed for submission of application
  • Application Process has Four Modules:
    • Module 1: Account Creation - Can be filled anytime (common for all exams)
    • Module 2: Universal Registration (URN) - Can be filled anytime (common for all exams). URN generated is unique and remains constant for all UPSC exams
    • Module 3: Common Application Form (CAF) - Can be filled anytime (common for all exams)
    • Module 4: Examination Specific Module - Can be filled only during notification period (includes fees, centres, force preferences, etc.)
  • Documents Required:
    • Recent passport-size colour photograph (scanned in .jpg format, 20 KB to 200 KB)
    • Signature (scanned - sign three times one below other on plain white paper using black ink, .jpg format, 20 KB to 100 KB)
    • Live photograph (to be captured while filling CAF)
    • One Photo ID Card details (Aadhaar/Voter/PAN/Passport/Driving License/Any other Government Photo ID)
    • Date of Birth certificate (Matriculation/Secondary School Leaving Certificate)
    • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
    • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) in prescribed format, if applicable
    • OBC candidates: OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate based on income for FY 2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23, issued on/after 01.04.2025 but not later than 12.03.2026
    • EWS candidates: EWS Certificate based on income for FY 2024-25, issued on/after 01.04.2025 but not later than 12.03.2026
    • Ex-servicemen: Prescribed Certificate and Undertaking as per Appendix-VI(A) and VI(B)
  • Read General Instructions, Profile/Module-wise Instructions, and Instructions for uploading documents carefully before filling the form
  • Prepare requisite documents in advance for smooth flow during form filling
  • Pay application fee (if applicable) through Net Banking/Credit/Debit Card/UPI
  • Select examination centre from available options (first-apply-first-allot basis)
  • Indicate force preferences (BSF/CRPF/CISF/ITBP/SSB)

Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official HPRCA website. The last date to submit the application form is 04-04-2026. In this article, you’ll find the HPRCA Panchayat Secretary, Pharmacist and More Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

Details Information
Organization Name Himachal Pradesh Rajya Chayan Aayog (HPRCA)

Application End Date 04/04/2026
Application Mode Online
Official Website hprca.hp.gov.in

HPRCA Various Posts 2026 Vacancy Details

The vacancy details for HPRCA Recruitment 2026 under Advertisement No. 04/2026 are as follows:

Post Name Department Total Vacancies
Panchayat Secretary (Job Trainee) – Zila Parishad Cadre Department of Panchayati Raj, HP 119
Medical Social Worker (On Regular basis) Department of Medical Education & Research, HP 02
Psychiatric Social Worker (Job Trainee) Department of Medical Education & Research, HP 05
Operation Theatre Assistant (Job Trainee) Dept. of Health Services, HP & Dept. of Medical Education & Research, HP 145 + 31 = 176
Radiographer (Job Trainee) Dept. of Health Services, HP & Dept. of Medical Education & Research, HP 05 + 05 = 10
Pharmacist/Pharmacy Officer (Job Trainee) Department of Medical Education & Research, HP 04
Speech Therapist (Job Trainee) Department of Medical Education & Research, HP 03
Senior Laboratory Technician / MLT Gr-II (Job Trainee) Department of Medical Education & Research, HP 10
Audiometric Technician (Job Trainee) Department of Medical Education & Research, HP 01
Litho Artist (As Trainee) Department of Printing & Stationery 01

Note: The number of posts is tentative and may increase or decrease. District-wise breakup for Post Code 26005 (Panchayat Secretary) is available in the official notification PDF.

Eligibility Criteria for HPRCA Various Posts 2026

1. Age Limit

The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 45 years for all advertised posts, except for Post Code 26013 (Audiometric Technician – Job Trainee) and Post Code 26011 (Speech Therapist – Job Trainee) where the age limit is 18–38 years. Age is reckoned as on 01.01.2026. Upper age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates domiciled in Himachal Pradesh and for HP Government employees and Ex-servicemen of HP.

2. Educational Qualification (Post-wise)

Post Name (Code) Essential Qualification
Panchayat Secretary (26005) Bachelor's Degree from a recognised Institution approved by HP Government/University/Board. Minimum typing speed of 30 wpm in English or 25 wpm in Hindi on computer. Knowledge of word processing as prescribed by the recruiting authority.
Medical Social Worker (26006) Post Graduate Degree in Social Science or Sociology from a University recognised by the Central or HP Government.
Psychiatric Social Worker (26007) Master Degree in Psychology or Social Work.
Operation Theatre Assistant (26008) 10+2 with Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) with 50% from a recognised Board/Institution and OTA Training course from a recognised Institution by the State Government. OR B.Sc. Degree in Medical Technology (Anesthesia & OT Techniques) from HP University or equivalent. Must be registered with HP Paramedical Council.
Radiographer (26009) 10+2 in Science from a recognised Board/University. B.Sc. Medical Technology (Radiology & Imaging) or equivalent degree from a recognised University. Must be registered with HP Para Medical Council (Presently State Allied Health Care Council, HP).
Pharmacist/Pharmacy Officer (26010) 10+2 with Science from a recognised Board of School Education. Degree or Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognised University/Institution duly recognised by Central/State Government. Must be registered with the Pharmacy Council of the concerned State/Central Government.
Speech Therapist (26011) B.Sc. Degree in Speech & Hearing or its equivalent from a recognised University or Institution duly recognised by the Central or State Government.
Senior Laboratory Technician/MLT Gr-II (26012) 10+2 in Science from a recognised Board. B.Sc. Medical Laboratory Technology or equivalent degree from a recognised University. Must be registered with HP Para Medical Council (Presently State Allied Health Care Council, HP).
Audiometric Technician (26013) B.Sc. Degree in Speech & Hearing or its equivalent from a recognised University or Institution duly recognised by Central or State Government.
Litho Artist (26014) 10+2 or equivalent from a recognised Board. Diploma in Fine Arts (minimum 3 years) from an institution recognised by HP Government. Three years practical experience in commercial design and layout in Government/Semi Government or Private Press having offset unit and ISO certification.

3. Nationality

Candidates must be Indian citizens. The benefit of reservation is admissible only to bonafide residents of Himachal Pradesh. Candidates of reserved categories from other states shall be treated as General (UR) category candidates.

Selection Process for HPRCA Various Posts 2026

The selection for HPRCA Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following process:

  • Computer Based Test (CBT) / Written Screening Test: Objective type test of 120 marks with duration of 1½ hours (one and a half hours). Each question carries 1 mark.
  • Typing / Skill Test: Mandatory and qualifying in nature for Post Code 26005 (Panchayat Secretary). Minimum typing speed of 30 wpm in English or 25 wpm in Hindi on computer.
  • Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification.

Syllabus

  • Subject(s)/field(s) up to the level of prescribed essential qualification as notified in the advertisement.
  • General Knowledge including General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh and Current Affairs.
  • Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi of Matric Standard.

Minimum qualifying marks: 45% for General category and 40% for SC/ST/OBC/WFF candidates. In case of multiple shifts, scores will be normalised using the Z-Score Method (Mean and Standard Deviation Method).

Application Fee for HPRCA Various Posts 2026

Category Examination Fee Processing Fee Total Fee
All Categories ₹100/- ₹700/- ₹800/-
Correction Window Fee ₹100/- (opened 3 working days after closing date, valid for 7 days)

Payment Mode: Online Payment Gateway only – Credit Card / Debit Card / Net Banking. No other mode of payment is accepted. Examination and processing fee once paid will not be refunded.

How to Apply for HPRCA Various Posts Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can apply online for HPRCA Various Posts 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official website: hprca.hp.gov.in
  2. Click on "Sign Up" to create a username and password on the HPRCA portal.
  3. Complete the One-Time Registration (OTR) by providing personal information, educational qualifications, work experience (if any), and uploading a recent photograph and signature.
  4. Complete/Update your profile. Only users with complete profiles can apply.
  5. Click on the "Apply" button for the desired post under Advertisement No. 04/2026.
  6. Select your preferred exam district from the dropdown menu.
  7. Review auto-filled application details and confirm.
  8. Pay the application fee of ₹800/- through the online payment gateway (Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking).
  9. After successful payment, your application will be considered complete. Download and print the application form for future reference.

Note: No Offline Application Form will be accepted by HPRCA. Applications through fax/post shall not be entertained. Only one application per post is allowed — multiple applications for the same post are liable to be rejected.

Important Instructions for HPRCA Recruitment 2026

  • Candidates must register on the One Time Registration (OTR) portal before filling the ORA (Online Recruitment Application).
  • The online application can be filled from 10.03.2026 (10:00 AM) to 04.04.2026 till 11:59 PM, after which the website link will be disabled.
  • Eligibility of all candidates in respect of Essential Qualifications and Experience shall be determined as on the prescribed closing date i.e. 04/04/2026.
  • The benefit of reservation is admissible only to bonafide residents of Himachal Pradesh. Candidates of reserved categories from other states will be treated as General (UR) category.
  • OBC category certificate validity is one year or as prescribed by the HP Government, and must be valid on the last date of ORA submission as well as on the date of document verification.
  • EWS category certificate validity is one year from the date of its issuance and must be valid throughout the selection process.
  • The candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC of Himachal Pradesh must possess caste certificates on parental basis. The SC of HP/ST of HP/OBC of HP certificates must be on parental basis.
  • Candidates currently in regular Government service must submit a declaration that they have informed their Head of Office/Department about their application.
  • The candidate must have passed Matriculation and 10+2 from any school/institution situated within Himachal Pradesh to be eligible for appointment (not applicable to Bonafide Himachalis).

  • Disc Code 101 – Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.

  • Disc Code 105 – Technician Apprentice (Electrical & Electronics): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates.   • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. MECON Limited Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

Junior Engineer (Mechanical):

  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering. Minimum 16 years post-qualification experience in construction/supervision of projects in Hydrocarbon industry (process plants, pipelines, refinery, LPG plant, depots, compressor/pumping stations etc.).
  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering & NDT Level-2 Certification. Minimum 16 years post-qualification experience in construction/supervision of projects in Hydrocarbon industry.

Junior Engineer (Civil)

  • Diploma in Civil Engineering. Minimum 16 years post-qualification experience in design/site supervision for building construction/industrial projects.
  • Diploma in Civil Engineering. Minimum 16 years post-qualification experience in construction/supervision of industrial projects, preferably in Hydrocarbon industry.

Junior Engineer (Electrical)

  • Diploma in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engineering (or combination where Electrical is one branch). Minimum 16 years post-qualification experience in design/construction of electrical works for building/infrastructure/industrial projects.

Junior Officer (HR)

  • BBA / Graduate in any discipline. Minimum 16 years post-qualification experience in the entire gamut of HR.

Junior Officer (Admin.)

  • BBA / Graduate in any discipline. Minimum 16 years post-qualification experience in administrative work.

Age Limit (as on 02.02.2026)

Post Codes Grade Upper Age Limit Pay Scale
01 to 07 E-0 50 years (before relaxations and additional experience-based relaxation) Rs. 30,000–3%–1,20,000/- (IDA)

Upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL), and by 10/13/15 years for PwD (UR/OBC/SC-ST) as per Government of India guidelines. Candidates domiciled in J&K during 01.01.1980–31.12.1989, Ex-Servicemen and other categories receive relaxation as per rules, subject to a maximum age not exceeding 52 years on the cut-off date.

Additionally, 1 year of age relaxation is provided for every 1 year of additional relevant experience, limited to a maximum of 3 years, within the overall upper age cap of 52 years.

Work Experience Definition

Only full-time, regular salary-based work in relevant areas will be considered towards the required 16 years of post-qualification experience. Freelance, entrepreneurial, teaching, research, articleship/internship (other than certain PSU training and apprenticeship as specified) will not be counted.

Eligibility Criteria: DHFWS ANM Recruitment 2026

DHFWS ensures accessible criteria with relaxations for reserved groups—review these to confirm your fit.

Educational Qualification

Pass in 12th Std. (HSC) or equivalent, plus Diploma in Multipurpose Health Worker (Female)/Auxiliary Nurse Midwife from a recognized institution. Must hold permanent registration as a Midwife from any State Nursing Council in India. Regional language (Tamil/Telugu/Malayalam) studied up to SSLC level required.

Age Limit

18-30 years as of March 8, 2026. Relaxations: 3 years (MBC/OBC/EBC/BCM), 5 years (SC), military service +3 years (Ex-Servicemen), 10 years (PwBD, plus category relaxations), up to 35/40 years (widows/divorced/judicially separated women, General/SC).

Experience

No prior experience needed—open to freshers. Seniority marks (up to 15) awarded for Employment Exchange registration post-Diploma.

Nativity: Must be UT native/resident for 5+ years; fresh certificate required on selection.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern: DHFWS ANM Recruitment 2026

Merit-driven and transparent, with no written exam—focus on your academics and registration history.

Selection Process

  1. Merit List: Based on 50% HSC marks + 50% Diploma marks (deduct 5% per extra attempt) + up to 15 seniority marks (1.5/year from Diploma registration in Employment Exchange).
  2. Total Score: Out of 115 marks.
  3. Wait List: Valid 1 year for unfilled spots.
  4. Certificate Verification: For provisionally selected candidates.

Exam Pattern

No exam; purely marks-based computation. Ties resolved by: Diploma marks > HSC marks > Date of birth (older preferred) > Alphabetical order. Regional language knowledge verified for placement.

  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE.   • Recruitment is purely based on merit depending on available vacancies.

  2. If new user, complete the registration process by providing basic details and creating a login ID.

  4. Upload required documents, photographs, and signatures as per specifications.
  5. Pay the examination fee of Rs 250/- online.
  6. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

Note: Applications invited from domiciles of all districts of Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, UT of Chandigarh & Delhi. Any change in policy or details published in notification will be intimated on registered email/mobile number and with a ticker on the www.joinindianarmy.nic.in web portal.

  • Single Bank A/C, PAN Card & AADHAR Card.
  • Police Verification Form.
  • Certificate from serving personnel for wards of serving soldiers (if applicable).
  • Any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

Agniveers will be paid a customized package with fixed yearly increment. In addition, Risk and Hardship, Ration, Dress and Travel allowances as applicable.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Nationality

The candidate must be a citizen of India.

Educational Qualification

  • Must possess a BDS or equivalent Degree from a Medical College or Medical Institution recognized by the Dental Council of India (DCI).
  • Must possess a valid Registration Certificate under the Dentist Act, 1948.
  • Candidates having degrees from foreign universities must possess required Conversion Certificates recognized by DCI.

Additional Requirements

  • Houseman-ship/Internship Completion Certificate
  • Certificate relating to passing of the screening test conducted by the National Board of Examinations (for candidates from foreign universities)
  • Odia language test pass certificate, or must pass the required Odia examination within 4 years of joining service

Odia Language Requirement

Candidate must be able to read, write, and speak Odia and must have fulfilled any one of the following:

  • Passed Middle School Examination in Odia as a language subject; OR
  • Passed Matriculation or equivalent examination with Odia as medium of examination in non-language subject; OR
  • Passed in Odia as language subject in the final examination of Class-VII or above; OR
  • Passed a test in Odia in Middle English School standard conducted by the School and Mass Education Department.

Proviso: If a candidate has not passed Middle School Examination in Odia as a language subject, he/she shall be required to pass the examination conducted by the Board of Secondary Education, Odisha within 4 years of joining service. Failing this, no further increment will be sanctioned and promotion to Group-A (Senior Branch) will not be allowed.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Age Limit (as on 01 January 2026)

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 42 years
  • Candidate must not have been born earlier than 02 January 1984 and not later than 01 January 2005.

Age Relaxation

Category Upper Age Limit Relaxation

ST 5 years
Women candidates 5 years
Ex-Servicemen 5 years
PwBD (40% or more permanent disability) 10 years
PwBD belonging to SEBC/SC/ST categories 15 years (cumulative benefit)
  • A candidate who comes under more than one category shall be eligible for only one benefit of upper age relaxation, whichever is more beneficial.
  • Exception: PwBD candidates belonging to SEBC/SC/ST categories shall be eligible for 15 years cumulative age relaxation.
  • Date of birth in High School Certificate or equivalent certificate issued by the concerned Board/Council will only be accepted.
  • Save as provided above, the age limits prescribed can in no case be relaxed.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Salary & Pay Scale

Selected candidates will be appointed in Level-12, Cell-1 of the Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017 and will also be entitled to Dearness Allowance (DA) and other admissible allowances as sanctioned by the Government from time to time.

  • Refunds will be processed to the original mode of payment used at the time of transaction.
  • Candidates must furnish bank account details in the online application form for refund in case of technical glitches.
  • Bank account must remain valid and active. The Commission will not entertain correspondence regarding incorrect bank details.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Selection Process

The selection shall be made on the basis of a Written Test as per the Odisha Medical Services (Method of Recruitment and Conditions of Service of Dental Surgeons) Rules, 2022 along with Amendment Rules, 2025.

Written Examination Pattern

Qualifying Marks Will be decided by OPSC
Exam Date 21 June 2026 (Sunday) – Tentative
Exam Centre Cuttack / Bhubaneswar

Sl. No. Discipline/Subject Marks Allocated

Merit List Preparation

  • The Commission shall prepare a list of candidates in order of merit on the basis of the Written Test equal to the number of advertised vacancies.
  • If two or more candidates secure equal marks, the candidate securing higher marks in the BDS Examination will rank higher.
  • If marks in the BDS Examination are also equal, the candidate older in age will be placed above the younger candidate.
  • The recommendation list shall remain valid for one year from the date of recommendation or till the next recruitment is made by the Commission.
  • A Sports Person must secure the qualifying marks of his/her category for inclusion in the merit list.

Answer Key & Result

  • Provisional Answer Keys shall be uploaded on the website within 10 days of examination.
  • Candidates can submit objections/suggestions against the provisional answer key.
  • Candidates who do not challenge the provisional answer key shall forfeit their right to agitate the matter later.
  • Cut-off marks, answer keys, and individual marks will be declared only after publication of the final result and select list.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Apply Online – Step-by-Step Process

  1. Visit the official website: https://opsc.gov.in
  2. Read Advertisement No. 07 of 2025-26 carefully before applying.
  3. Click on the Apply Online link for Dental Surgeon recruitment from 17.03.2026 to 17.04.2026 (5:00 PM).
  4. Read detailed instructions available on the OPSC portal.
  5. Complete online registration to obtain a unique Permanent Public Service Account Number (PPSAN).
  6. Fill the automated online application form with accurate personal, contact, category, educational, registration, Odia test, and bank details.
  7. Upload scanned copies of required documents in the prescribed format and size.
  8. Upload recent passport size photograph, full signature, and left-hand thumb impression.
  9. Pay the examination fee online, if applicable.
  10. Verify all details carefully before final submission.
  11. Submit the application form successfully.
  12. Take a printout of the finally submitted application form for future reference.
  13. Note down your Application Number (USER ID) and PPSAN for future correspondence.

Documents to be Uploaded

  • 10th Pass Certificate & Mark Sheet
  • BDS Degree Certificate & All Mark Sheets
  • Houseman-ship/Internship Completion Certificate

  • Screening Test Certificate (for foreign degree holders)

  • Sports Identity Card/Certificate

  • Odia language test pass certificate
  • Proof of Identity (Aadhar/EPIC/DL/Passport/PAN Card)
  • Recent passport size photograph
  • Full signature
  • Left-hand Thumb Impression (LTI)

Important Guidelines

  • Submit the application well before the last date to avoid last-hour rush.
  • If any correction is needed after submission, the candidate must cancel the previous application and apply afresh within the closing date.
  • Applications submitted through offline mode, email, or post will not be accepted.
  • Uploaded documents must be clearly visible; otherwise, the application may be rejected.
  • Keep at least four copies of the same passport size photograph used in the application.
  • Ensure all details are correct because the application process is automated and system driven.

How to Apply for OPSC Dental Surgeon Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted in online mode only through https://opsc.gov.in from 17 March 2026 to 17 April 2026 (5:00 PM).

  • The Admit Card will be uploaded on the OPSC website before the exam date.
  • Candidates must download and produce the admit card at the examination centre.
  • No separate communication will be made for admit card issuance.
  • Notice for document verification shall also be uploaded on the OPSC website.
  • Candidates qualified in the written exam must bring hard copy of the online application along with self-attested copies and originals of all required certificates for verification.
  • Each document copy must mention: “Submitted by me and Certified as genuine and has not been cancelled” with full signature and date.
  • Government servants must inform their Head of Office in writing and furnish a No Objection Certificate during document verification.
  • Candidates debarred by OPSC, UPSC, or any other State PSC will not be eligible to apply during the debarment period.
  • Admission to the written examination will be purely provisional.
  • Any complaint regarding conduct of examination must be sent to the Grievance Wing by email within 7 days of completion of examination.

OPTCL Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Download

OPTCL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Nationality

  • The candidate must be a citizen of India.

Educational Qualification

Sl. No. Post Name Essential Qualification
1 Management Trainee (Civil) Degree in Civil Engineering with at least 60% marks in aggregate from a recognized University/Institution in regular mode OR Passing of Section A & B of IE (India) in Civil Engineering with minimum 50% marks.
For SC and ST: minimum 50% marks required.
2 Management Trainee (Law) Degree in Law from a recognized Institution.
3 Junior Management Trainee (Civil) Diploma in Civil Engineering in regular mode with at least 60% marks in aggregate from a recognized University/Institution.
For SC and ST: minimum 50% marks required.
4 Office Assistant Grade-III Trainee Bachelor's degree or equivalent from a recognized University/Institution with minimum 60% marks.
For SC, ST and PwBD: minimum 50% marks required.

Additional Requirements:
a. Must be able to read and write Odia.
b. Must have working knowledge in Computer (MS Word, Excel & PowerPoint) and be able to type, edit, print, store documents.

Note I: Degree/Diploma obtained from Open University (except IGNOU) / Distance Learning Mode / Part-Time / Sandwich Course shall NOT be considered.

Note II: For Office Assistant Grade-III Trainee, candidates with higher qualification not related to the nature of work shall NOT be considered for the post.

OPTCL Recruitment 2026 Age Limit (as on 01.02.2026)

  • Minimum age: 21 years.​

  • Maximum age: 32 years.

Age Relaxation

Category Age Relaxation
SC / ST / SEBC candidates 5 years
Women candidates 5 years
PwBD candidates 10 years
Ex-Servicemen (for OA Grade-III Trainee only) Actual service period deducted from age
Outsourced contractual candidates (MT/JMT) with 1 year service in OPTCL/GRIDCO 5 years (in addition to other relaxations)
Outsourced contractual candidates (OA Grade-III) with 1 year service in OPTCL Upper age limit extended to 45 years

Important Notes:
 - A person under more than one category (except PwBD) shall be eligible for only ONE benefit of upper age relaxation, whichever is most beneficial.
- PwBD candidates for Office Assistant Grade-III Trainee shall be eligible for cumulative age relaxation.
- No age relaxation for SC/ST/SEBC candidates applying against UR vacancies.
- Date of birth in High School Certificate / Birth Certificate issued by concerned authority will only be accepted.
- The age limits prescribed can in NO CASE be relaxed.

OPTCL Recruitment 2026 Salary & Stipend

During Training Period ​

Post Name Consolidated Stipend (per month) Training Period
Management Trainee (Civil/Law) ₹50,000/- 1 year
Junior Management Trainee (Civil) ₹30,000/- 1 year
Office Assistant Grade-III Trainee ₹20,000/- 1 year

After Successful Completion of Training ​

Post After Training Grade Pay Matrix Initial Basic Pay
Assistant Manager (Civil/Law) E-3 Grade ₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500 (Level: EE-2) ₹56,100/-
Junior Manager (Civil) E-2 Grade ₹44,900 - ₹1,42,400 (Level: EE-1) ₹44,900/-
Office Assistant Grade-III NE-6 Grade ₹29,300 - ₹92,400 (Level: NE-6) ₹29,300/-

Additional Benefits: Besides Initial Basic Pay, DA, HRA or Company Accommodation, Medical Allowance, Conveyance Allowance, other applicable allowances, Medical Insurance, NPS and various loans/advances shall be paid as per applicable rules of the Corporation.

Probation Period: 1 year after absorption in regular establishment.

OPTCL Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

Category Application Fee
UR and SEBC candidates ₹1,180/- (₹1,000 + ₹180 GST)
SC/ST/PwBD candidates (Odisha only) ₹590/- (₹500 + ₹90 GST)
OPTCL Departmental candidates Exempted from fee

Mode of Payment: Online only (Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking, etc.).

Note: Application fee once paid shall NOT be refunded in any case. Candidates shall bear the online transaction charges extra as applicable.

OPTCL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process involves:​

  1. Computer Based Test (CBT)

  2. Personal Interview / Skill Test

  3. Document Verification

  4. Medical Fitness Test

Computer Based Test (CBT)​

  • Total Questions: 200 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)

  • Duration: 3 hours

  • Marking Scheme: +1 mark for correct answer, -0.25 mark for wrong answer

How to Apply for OPTCL Recruitment 2026

  • Applications must be submitted in online mode only through the official website during 16 March 2026 (05:00 PM) to 15 April 2026 (11:59 PM).

  • Candidates should ensure they fulfill all eligibility criteria on the specified dates and the particulars furnished are correct in all respects.

  • In case it is detected at any stage of recruitment/selection that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or has furnished any incorrect/false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), candidature will automatically stand cancelled.

  • If any shortcoming is detected even after appointment, services are liable to be terminated without any notice.

  • Candidates working in State/Central Government/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies shall apply through proper channel and produce "No Objection Certificate" at the time of Personal Interview/Document verification.

  • Final selection is subject to medical fitness as per prescribed standards.

  • On selection, candidates are liable to be posted at any of the existing/upcoming units of OPTCL throughout Odisha.

Note: The number of vacancies mentioned above is tentative and liable to alteration. Reservation will be given effect to as per Government policy. 10% of the total vacancies are earmarked for Ex-servicemen.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Nationality:
    • A candidate must be a citizen of India
    • With the consent of the Central Government signified in writing, subjects of Nepal or Bhutan may also be appointed
  • Sex: Both Male and Female candidates are eligible for appointment to the post of Assistant Commandants
  • Educational Qualification:
    • A candidate must hold a Bachelor's degree of a University incorporated by an Act of the Central or State Legislature in India
    • OR from educational institutions established by an Act of Parliament
    • OR declared to be deemed as a University under Section-3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956
    • OR possess an equivalent qualification
    • Candidates who have appeared at an examination the passing of which would render them educationally qualified but have not been informed of the results will also be eligible
    • Candidates who intend to appear at such a qualifying examination in the year 2026 will also be eligible
    • However, qualified candidates must produce proof of passing the requisite qualifying examination (Degree Certificate/Final Mark Sheet/Provisional Degree Certificate) within the time limit prescribed in the Rules
    • Degree/Post Graduate/Diploma qualifications acquired through distance learning/part-time are NOT considered
  • Important Notes:
    • In exceptional cases, the Commission may treat a candidate who does not have the foregoing qualifications as qualified, provided the candidate has passed an examination of equivalent standard
    • Candidates possessing professional and technical qualifications recognized by Government as equivalent to professional and technical degrees are also eligible
    • All qualifications must be from UGC-recognised Universities/Deemed Universities/MHRD-approved autonomous institutions

    • No other document relating to age (Horoscopes, Affidavits, Birth extracts from Municipal Corporation, Service records) will be accepted
    • Once Date of Birth has been submitted in the Online Application Form, no change will be allowed subsequently on any grounds whatsoever
    • Save as provided above, the age limits prescribed can in no case be relaxed

Application Fee

Category Application Fee
General/OBC/EWS (Male Candidates) Rs. 200/- (Rupees Two Hundred only)
All Female Candidates / SC / ST Candidates NIL (Exempted from payment of fee)
  • Payment Mode: Fee can be paid either by using Net Banking Facility of any Bank or by using Visa/Master/RuPay/Credit/Debit Card/UPI Payment only
  • Payment of fee through any other mode is neither valid nor acceptable
  • Applications submitted without the prescribed fee/mode (unless remission of fee is claimed) shall be summarily rejected
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances nor can the fee be held in reserve for any other examination or selection
  • Important: No fee exemption is available to OBC/EWS candidates and they are required to pay the full prescribed fee

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Notification Date 20/02/2026
Start Date of Online Application 20/02/2026
Last Date of Online Application 12/03/2026 (till 18:00 hours)
Written Examination Date 19th July, 2026
Written Exam Timing - Paper-I 10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon
Written Exam Timing - Paper-II 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM
e-Admit Card Download Date Last working day of preceding week of examination date
Physical Standards Tests / Physical Efficiency Tests After declaration of Written Exam result
Interview / Personality Test After PST/PET (for qualified candidates)
Medical Standards Tests After Interview / Personality Test

Selection Process

  • Stage 1: Written Examination (19th July, 2026)
    • Paper-I: General Ability and Intelligence - 250 Marks
      • Duration: 2 hours (10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon)
      • Type: Objective (Multiple Choice) Type questions
      • Medium: English as well as Hindi
      • Subjects: General Mental Ability (logical reasoning, quantitative aptitude, numerical ability, data interpretation), General Science, Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Polity & Economy, History of India, Indian & World Geography
      • There will be penalty (Negative Marking) for wrong answers: One third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for each wrong answer
    • Paper-II: General Studies, Essay and Comprehension - 200 Marks
      • Duration: 3 hours (2:00 PM to 5:00 PM)
      • Type: Conventional (Descriptive) Type
      • Part-A: Essay questions (80 Marks) - to be answered in long narrative form either in Hindi or English. Topics: modern Indian history especially freedom struggle, geography, polity and economy, security and human rights issues, analytical ability
      • Part-B: Comprehension, précis writing, other communications/language skills (120 Marks) - to be attempted in English only. Topics: Comprehension passages, précis writing, developing counter arguments, simple grammar and other language testing aspects
      • Candidates must write answers only in the medium allowed. No credit for answers written in other medium
    • There will be minimum qualifying marks separately in each Paper as may be fixed by the Commission
    • Paper-I will be evaluated first and Paper-II will be evaluated only for those who obtain minimum qualifying marks in Paper-I
  • Stage 2: Physical Standards Tests (PST) / Physical Efficiency Tests (PET)
    • Conducted for candidates qualified in Written Examination
    • Physical Standards Requirements:
      • Men: Height 165 cm, Chest 81 cm (unexpanded) with 5 cm minimum expansion, Weight 50 kg
      • Women: Height 157 cm, Weight 46 kg
      • Height and chest measurement will be measured correct to one decimal in centimeter
      • Weight should be as per height and age as per prescribed chart
    • Physical Efficiency Tests:
      • Men: 100 Meter Race in 16 Seconds, 800 Meter Race in 3 Min 45 Sec, Long Jump 3.5 Meters (3 Chances), Shot Put (7.26 Kg) 4.5 Meters (3 Chances)
      • Women: 100 Meter Race in 18 Seconds, 800 Meter Race in 4 Min 45 Sec, Long Jump 3.0 Meters (3 Chances)
    • Female candidates must submit self-declaration about pregnancy status before PST/PET
    • Conducted under supervision of Nodal Authority appointed by Ministry of Home Affairs
  • Stage 3: Interview / Personality Test
    • Only for candidates qualified in PST/PET
    • Marks: 150 Marks
    • Conducted by Union Public Service Commission
    • Candidates declared unqualified in PET will not be called for Interview
    • NCC 'B' or 'C' Certificate holders will be given consideration at Interview stage
  • Stage 4: Medical Standards Tests (MST)
    • Conducted only for candidates who appeared in Interview/Personality Test
    • Detailed Medical Standards prescribed for Eye Sight, Ear, Nose, Neck, Teeth, General Health, etc.
    • Eye Sight: Better eye 6/6 or 6/9 (corrected), Worse eye 6/12 or 6/9 (corrected), Near Vision N6/N9 (corrected), Colour Perception CP-III by ISIHARA plates
    • LASIK surgery correction permitted subject to prescribed criteria
    • Candidates declared 'UNFIT' can appear before Review Medical Board preferably next day of DME
    • Appeals against MST results must be made within 24 hours after declaration of DME results
    • Conducted under supervision of Nodal Authority appointed by Ministry of Home Affairs
  • Final Selection/Merit:
    • Merit list drawn on basis of marks obtained in Written Examination and Interview/Personality Test
    • Any candidate found not satisfying prescribed Medical Standards after MST will not be appointed
    • Tie Breaking Principle: (i) Higher marks in written total, (ii) Higher marks in Paper-I, (iii) Senior in age, (iv) At Commission's discretion

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply online only using the Commission's website: https://upsconline.nic.in
  • No other mode is allowed for submission of application
  • Application Process has Four Modules:
    • Module 1: Account Creation - Can be filled anytime (common for all exams)
    • Module 2: Universal Registration (URN) - Can be filled anytime (common for all exams). URN generated is unique and remains constant for all UPSC exams
    • Module 3: Common Application Form (CAF) - Can be filled anytime (common for all exams)
    • Module 4: Examination Specific Module - Can be filled only during notification period (includes fees, centres, force preferences, etc.)
  • Documents Required:
    • Recent passport-size colour photograph (scanned in .jpg format, 20 KB to 200 KB)
    • Signature (scanned - sign three times one below other on plain white paper using black ink, .jpg format, 20 KB to 100 KB)
    • Live photograph (to be captured while filling CAF)
    • One Photo ID Card details (Aadhaar/Voter/PAN/Passport/Driving License/Any other Government Photo ID)
    • Date of Birth certificate (Matriculation/Secondary School Leaving Certificate)
    • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
    • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) in prescribed format, if applicable
    • OBC candidates: OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate based on income for FY 2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23, issued on/after 01.04.2025 but not later than 12.03.2026
    • EWS candidates: EWS Certificate based on income for FY 2024-25, issued on/after 01.04.2025 but not later than 12.03.2026
    • Ex-servicemen: Prescribed Certificate and Undertaking as per Appendix-VI(A) and VI(B)
  • Read General Instructions, Profile/Module-wise Instructions, and Instructions for uploading documents carefully before filling the form
  • Prepare requisite documents in advance for smooth flow during form filling
  • Pay application fee (if applicable) through Net Banking/Credit/Debit Card/UPI
  • Select examination centre from available options (first-apply-first-allot basis)
  • Indicate force preferences (BSF/CRPF/CISF/ITBP/SSB)
  • Review all entered information carefully before final submission
  • Take printout or save soft copy of submitted application for future reference

  • Candidates are strongly advised to apply online well in time without waiting for the last date

  • Download e-Admit Card from Commission's website on last working day of preceding week of examination

Eligibility Criteria

  • Educational Qualification (Essential): A candidate must hold a Bachelor’s Degree from any University incorporated by an Act of the Central or a State Legislature in India or an Educational Institution established by an Act of Parliament or deemed to be a University under Section-3 of the UGC Act, 1956 or a Foreign University approved by the Central Government from time to time.
  • Odia Language Requirement: The candidate must be able to read, write and speak Odia and must have passed Middle School Examination with Odia as a language subject OR passed High School Certificate or equivalent examination with Odia as medium of examination in non-language subjects OR passed Odia as a language subject in final examination of Class-VII from a recognised school OR passed a test in Odia in Middle English School standard conducted by the Government of Odisha.
  • Marital Status Condition: A candidate who has more than one spouse living or, in case of a woman candidate, is married to a person having one spouse living, shall not be eligible unless exempted by the State Government.
  • Government Servants: Government servants (temporary or permanent) are eligible, provided they possess requisite qualifications and are within the prescribed age limit and obtain No Objection Certificate from the competent authority.
  • Character & Health: A candidate must have good moral character and be of sound mental and physical health and free from any physical defect likely to interfere with the discharge of duties.

  • For Odisha Police Service, Group-A (Junior Branch) – Group-A Service: Rs. 56,100/- in Level-12, Cell-1 in the Pay Matrix under Rule-3 of ORSP Rules, 2017.

Age Limit

  • Maximum Age: 42 years.
  • The candidate must not have been born earlier than 02/01/1983 and not later than 01/01/2004.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 5 years for SC, ST, SEBC, Women and Ex-Servicemen candidates.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 10 years for Persons with Disabilities having permanent disability of 40% or more; PwD candidates of SC/ST/SEBC categories are eligible for cumulative age relaxation.

Application Fee

  • Candidates other than SC, ST and PwD category shall have to pay examination fee of Rs. 700/- (Rupees Seven hundred only).
  • Payment Mode: Online mode while filling the Online Application Form (Credit Card, Debit Card, UPI, Net Banking, Wallet, etc.).
  • The examination fees paid shall be refunded only to those candidates who actually appear in both the papers of the Preliminary Examination.
  • Applications without payment of examination fee (except SC/ST/PwD candidates) will be treated as incomplete and summarily rejected.
  • Candidates must furnish bank account details in the Online Application Form for refund where required.

Selection Process

  • The Combined Competitive Recruitment Examination shall comprise:
    • Preliminary Examination (Objective type) for selection of candidates for Main Examination.
    • Main Examination (Written) and Interview for Personality Test for selection to various services and posts.
  • Preliminary Examination: Two compulsory papers of Objective Type (Multiple Choice Questions), General Studies Paper-I (200 marks) and General Studies Paper-II (200 marks), each of 2 hours duration.
  • General Studies Paper-II is a qualifying paper with minimum qualifying marks of 33; selection to Main Examination is based on marks in General Studies Paper-I and qualifying the Paper-II as per rules.
  • There shall be negative marking: for each wrong answer, one-third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question shall be deducted; multiple answers to a question are treated as wrong.
  • Main Examination: Written examination consists of nine papers – two qualifying language papers (Odia and English) in Part-I and seven papers in Part-II (Essay, General Studies-I, II, III, IV and two Optional subject papers).
  • Marks obtained in Part-II papers and Interview (Personality Test) are counted for ranking; language papers in Part-I are qualifying in nature.
  • Interview (Personality Test) carries 250 marks; final ranking is based on total marks of Main Written and Interview.
  • Candidates are allotted to various Services based on ranks and service preference.

General Information/Instructions

  • The provisions of the Odisha Conduct of Examinations Act, 1988 are applicable; any violation or malpractice will attract disciplinary action and possible criminal prosecution.
  • Penalty provisions under Rule-18 of Odisha Civil Services Combined Competitive Recruitment Examination Rules, 1991 shall apply.
  • Reservation and relaxation benefits for SC, ST and SEBC are admissible only to those categories of Odisha.
  • Community/caste status once mentioned in the online application shall be treated as final and cannot be changed later.
  • The advertisement does not bind the Government to make appointment; the number of vacancies is subject to change without notice depending on public service requirements.
  • Misrepresentation or suppression of information in the online application will result in cancellation of candidature and penalty as decided by the Commission.
  • Mere empanelment in the select list does not confer any right to appointment unless the Government is satisfied about suitability after necessary enquiry.
  • No request for withdrawal of candidature or change of category will be entertained.
  • Candidates must carefully fill service/post preference; change of preference after submission of online application will not be allowed.
  • Candidates must answer papers in their own handwriting; only PwD candidates with specified disabilities may use a scribe as per rules.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must go through the detailed advertisement available on the website of OPSC before filling the Online Application Form.
  • Candidates must apply online through the OPSC website (https://opsc.gov.in).
  • The link for registration and payment of examination fee will be available from 20/01/2026 to 20/02/2026 (5.00 P.M.).
  • The last date for submission of registered online application is 12/03/2026 (5.00 P.M.).
  • Applications received through any mode other than online shall not be accepted and will be summarily rejected.
  • After declaration of result of the Main Written Examination, candidates called for Interview/Personality Test will be required to submit print-out/hard copy of online application along with photocopies of documents as stated in the advertisement on the day of document verification.
