Eligibility Criteria

  • Applications are invited from eligible and interested candidates for filling up vacancies (Leave / Regular) that may arise during the academic year 2026-27 (from 01.04.2026 to 31.3.2027), purely on contract basis in Atomic Energy Central Schools-1 & 2, DAE Colony, ECIL Post, Hyderabad – 500 062.
  • Selection of candidates for the teaching posts of TGTs, PRTs and Balvatika Teachers will be prepared under Panel-I (with all requisite qualifications), Panel-II (without CTET for TGT & PRT) and Panel-III (without teaching qualification) as per notification.
  • Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) – General Essential Qualification: Three years Bachelor’s / Honours Degree with at least 50% marks in aggregate or equivalent CGPA in the subject(s) concerned or combination of subjects as mentioned in Table–1 and pass in B.Ed degree from a recognized University/Institution; OR four years integrated Bachelor’s Degree with B.Ed of Regional Institute of Education of NCTE or any NCTE-recognized institution with at least 50% marks or equivalent CGPA in the subject(s) concerned or combination of subjects as per Table–1.
  • For TGTs, qualification in Paper-II of Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) conducted by CBSE is essential for Panel-I.
  • TGT (English): Studied English as an Elective/Main subject in at least 3 years/6 semesters of the course; desirable: Knowledge of Computer Applications.
  • TGT (Social Science): Studied any two subjects out of History, Geography, Economics and Political Science during graduation, of which one must be either History or Geography in at least 3 years/6 semesters as Elective/Main subject and the second subject for at least one year/any two semesters; candidates under Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) with these subjects are also eligible; desirable: Knowledge of Computer Applications.
  • TGT (Hindi/Sanskrit): Studied Hindi/Sanskrit as an Elective/Main subject in at least 3 years/6 semesters of the course; desirable: Knowledge of Computer Applications.
  • TGT (Maths/Physics): Must have studied Mathematics as Elective/Main subject in at least 3 years/6 semesters, Physics for at least 1 year/any 2 semesters, and one of Chemistry, Electronics, Computer Science or Statistics for at least 1 year/any 2 semesters; candidates under CBCS with these subjects are also eligible; candidates with B.Sc (Hons.) in Physics or Chemistry are not eligible for TGT (Maths/Physics); desirable: Knowledge of Computer Applications.
  • TGT (Chemistry/Biology): Candidates should have studied Biology/Life Science/Botany/Zoology as Hons/Main Subject in at least 3 years/6 semesters with specified combinations of subsidiary subjects (Chemistry and Botany/Zoology) for at least one year or any 2 semesters; candidates under CBCS with these subjects are also eligible; desirable: Knowledge of Computer Applications.
  • TGT (Computer Science): B.Sc (Computer Science)/B.Sc (IT)/BCA or equivalent from recognized University with at least 50% marks in aggregate or equivalent CGPA; OR B.E/ B.Tech (Computer Science/IT/Computer Engineering) with at least 50% marks or equivalent CGPA; OR ‘A’ Level from ‘DOEACC’, Ministry of Information and Communication Technology with at least 50% marks or equivalent CGPA and a graduation degree in any subject from a recognized University; AND B.Ed Degree with at least 50% from NCTE recognized Institution/University; desirable: working knowledge of English and Hindi/other regional language and experience of working in a school.
  • Primary Teacher (PRT) – General Essential Qualification (Table-II, Sr. No. 07): Senior Secondary / Higher Secondary / Intermediate (10+2) with at least 50% marks and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (by whatever name known) from recognized Institute/Board; OR Senior Secondary / Higher Secondary / Intermediate (Class XII) with at least 50% marks and 4-years Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.) from recognized Institute/Board; OR Senior Secondary / Higher Secondary / Intermediate/Class-XII with at least 50% marks and 2-years Diploma in Education (Special Education) from Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI).
  • For PRT (general), qualification in Central Teacher Eligibility Test Paper-I conducted by Government of India is mandatory and proficiency to teach through Hindi and English medium is required; desirable: Knowledge of working on computer.
  • PRT (Telugu) (Table-II, Sr. No. 08): 50% pass marks in Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary School Certificate Test or Intermediate or equivalent with Telugu as a subject at +2 level and two years Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed.) from recognized Institution; OR 50% pass marks in Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate or equivalent with Telugu as a subject in +2 level and four years B.El.Ed from recognized Institution; OR 50% pass marks in Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate or equivalent with Telugu as a subject in +2 level and two years Diploma in Education (D.Ed) from a recognized Institution with proficiency in teaching Telugu as 2nd/3rd language up to class VIII and knowledge of Telugu grammar; desirable: experience of working in a school and knowledge of working on computer.
  • PRT (Music) (Table-II, Sr. No. 09): Senior Secondary / Higher Secondary / Intermediate (Class XII) with 50% marks from recognized board and Bachelor’s Degree in Music/Performing Arts from a recognized Institution/University, provided music is studied as main subject in all years of the degree; working knowledge of Hindi and English is required; candidates having only diploma in music are not eligible; desirable: Knowledge of Computer applications.
  • Balvatika Teacher (BVT) (Table-III, Sr. No. 10): Pass in Senior Secondary / Higher Secondary School Certificate Examination or Intermediate or its equivalent with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate or equivalent CGPA with English as subject in +2 level; plus Diploma in Nursery Teachers Education / Pre-School Education / Early Childhood Education Programme (D.E.C.Ed) of duration not less than two years, or B.Ed (Nursery) from NCTE recognized Institution; proficiency in teaching in English Medium and working knowledge of Computer are required; desirable: working knowledge of Hindi.
  • Note: For TGT posts, candidates without B.Ed but having 60% and above marks in Science subjects and 55% marks in Humanities in Graduation may be considered if candidates with requisite qualification are not available, at the discretion of the institution.
  • Graduates can be considered for the post of PRTs if candidates with +2 with D.Ed are not available, at the sole discretion of the institution.
  • PRTs shortlisted candidates should be willing to teach Balvatika classes, and it will be the right of Atomic Energy Education Society to do so.
  • For Panel-I, CTET qualification is a must for PRTs (Paper-I) and TGTs (Paper-II).
  • Proficiency in teaching in English is compulsory for all categories except regional language.
  • Teachers retired from KVS, NVS and AEES are eligible to apply for contract teacher posts, provided they are below the age of 65 years and they have to appear in Skill test and Demo Teaching Class.
  • Candidates applying for contract teachers’ posts should have experience of taking online/offline classes and possess computer knowledge to take online classes and conduct online tests.

Salary/Stipend

  • Balvatika Teacher (BVT) will be paid Rs. 27,625/- per month (Consolidated) with applicable TDS as per rule 17.
  • Primary Teacher (PRT) and Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) will be paid Rs. 34,125/- per month (Consolidated) with applicable TDS as per rule 17.
  • All posts are purely on contract basis for the academic year 2026-27 (from 01.04.2026 to 31.3.2027) and payment will be as per the notified consolidated pay.

Age Limit (as on 01-04-2026)

  • Balvatika Teacher (BVT): Maximum age 30 years as on 01-04-2026.
  • Primary Teacher (PRT): Maximum age 35 years as on 01-04-2026.
  • Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT): Maximum age 35 years as on 01-04-2026.
  • Age relaxation up to 5 years is applicable for SC/ST candidates.
  • Age relaxation up to 3 years is applicable for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates.
  • Age relaxation up to 10 years is applicable for Women candidates.
  • Age relaxation for Physically Challenged candidates is as per Government of India norms.
  • All the age relaxations will be concurrent; if a person is eligible for more than one concession, only one concession of the highest permissible limit will be granted.

Application Fee

  • The advertisement does not mention any application fee.
  • It is stated that applications received after due date and time will be summarily rejected, but no fee payment process is described.

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Advertisement 07.03.2026

Reporting Time on Scheduled Test Dates Between 8:00 am to 12 Noon (no candidate will be entertained beyond reporting hours or scheduled days/dates)

Selection Process

  • Selection of the candidates for the teaching posts i.e., TGTs, PRTs and Balvatika Teachers will be prepared under Panel-I, Panel-II and Panel-III as per prescribed qualification combinations.
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be called for Skill Test and Practical classroom observation (Demo Teaching Class).
  • On the day of Skill Test and Demo Teaching Class, candidates must produce original documents of essential and desirable qualifications along with the application form uploaded against the link for verification of eligibility.
  • If the number of candidates registered for the Skill Test increases, the number of days for the Skill Test may be correspondingly extended and such information will be displayed on the notice board of AECS-2, Hyderabad, DAE Colony, D-Sector Gate, ECIL Post, Hyderabad – 500062.
  • Candidates must come prepared for Skill Test and Demo Teaching; they will be given a chance to present their own prepared topic as well as another topic randomly chosen by them from a box on the spot.
  • Marks scored in both years of Intermediate or 12th marks (for +2) will be taken for deciding the cut-off marks for shortlisting candidates for PRTs and Balvatika Teachers.
  • Marks scored in all three/four years of graduation including languages will be considered for deciding the cut-off marks for shortlisting candidates for TGT posts.
  • If the number of applications is more in any category/subject, eligibility criteria (cut off percentage) will be decided at the sole discretion of AEC Schools, Hyderabad and no communication will be entertained in this regard.

How to Apply

  • Candidates have to submit duly filled in application with all relevant photocopies of documents of essential and desirable qualifications.
  • The application form is to be downloaded from www.nfc.gov.in, www.aecshyd1.edu.in, www.aecshyd2.edu.in, www.amd.gov.in and www.ecil.co.in.

  • Reporting time for all candidates is between 8:00 am to 12 Noon on the scheduled dates of respective tests; no candidate will be entertained beyond the reporting hours and scheduled days/dates.
  • Applications received after the due date and time will be summarily rejected.

Selection Process

  • Candidates must register successfully on NAPS/NATS portal and apply against the notification to be considered for the selection process.
  • There will be no written test or interview.
  • A merit list will be prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential prescribed qualification for the respective post.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification.
  • Shortlisted candidates must complete a Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test and be adjudged medically fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical format.
  • Candidates whose documents and Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Certificate are found in order shall be issued an Offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training.
  • Opportunities not filled through the initial shortlisting shall be filled by eligible candidates from the merit cum panel list for the same opportunity.

General Information / Instructions

  • Candidates must apply only for ONE discipline code. Applications for more than one discipline code will be summarily rejected.
  • Applicants must submit applications only against vacancies notified under the states of Western Region (Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, UT of Daman & Diu, UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli). Selection of training locations outside notified states will result in rejection.
  • Candidate profile on the portal must be 100% complete (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category, etc.).
  • The candidature of the applicant shall be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates and testimonials.
  • Any false or incorrect information furnished at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature and liability for criminal prosecution.
  • Candidates should maintain the same registered email ID and mobile number till completion of apprenticeship training.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats shall be considered subject to fulfilling standards applicable to General category candidates.
  • PwBD candidates are NOT eligible to apply for Discipline Codes 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110, 111.
  • Reservation will be applicable as per the prescribed percentage for the respective States/UT.
  • No. of seats indicated is tentative and may increase or decrease at the absolute discretion of management.
  • Upon completion of the Apprenticeship period, IOCL shall have NO obligation to offer employment, nor can an Apprentice claim the right for employment.
  • A minimum one-year gap between two apprenticeship trainings is required, provided the previous training is completed.
  • All future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on IOCL website: https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships.
  • For OBC-NCL category, candidates must submit a latest caste certificate not more than 12 months old from 28.02.2026 in the Proforma prescribed by Govt. of India.
  • Canvassing of any kind shall disqualify the candidate.

How to Apply

  • Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria must apply online only through the NAPS/NATS Portal.
  • For Trade Apprentice (ITI/Data Entry Operator): Register at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/ (NAPS)
  • For Technician Apprentice (Diploma) and Graduate Apprentice: Register at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php (NATS)
  • After registration, login to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using your User ID/Email ID and APPLY for apprenticeship openings using the following Establishment IDs of IOCL (Marketing Division) – Western Region:
    • NATS Establishment ID: WMHMCC000053
    • NAPS Establishment ID: E01172700332
  • Application window: 11.03.2026 (10:00 AM) to 26.03.2026 (5:00 PM).
  • No other means or mode of application will be accepted.
  • Ensure your profile is 100% complete with Personal Details, Educational Details, and Category before applying.
  • Before applying, keep ready: PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account details with Cheque Book (name printed), and scanned copies of Educational Qualification Certificates.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well in advance before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.
  • Candidates registered with Local/State Employment Exchange(s) / Vocational Rehabilitation Centre for PwBD and meeting prescribed eligibility criteria must apply through NAPS/NATS Portal.

General Information / Instructions

  • The post of Secretary (HOD) in Mormugao Port Authority in the pay scale of Rs.100000-260000 (Revised) (Pre-revised Rs.43200-66000) will fall vacant w.e.f. 13.02.2026, which is required to be filled by absorption through composite method from Officers of Major Port Authorities, fulfilling the eligibility criteria as per the RRs as indicated in the Annexure – I. attached herewith.
  • As directed by the Ministry vide letter dated 19.11.2019, the incumbent will be initially appointed to the HOD post in the scale of pay of Rs.100000-260000 (Revised) (pre-revised Rs.43200-66000) and after completion of three years' regular service in the post, he/she will be elevated to the scale of pay of Rs.120000-280000 (Revised) (pre-revised Rs.51300-73000) subject to fulfilling the relevant conditions as per the Ministry's guidelines vide letter No. A-12023/15/2018-PE-I dated 19.11.2019.
  • It may be noted that any changes as directed by the Ministry from time to time, will be made applicable.
  • As per the Ministry's guidelines dated 26.09.2019, in case of receipt of advance copy of application in respect of any applicant by the Port, candidature of the candidate will not be considered by the Ministry if his/her application is not received through proper channel by the Port within 15 days of the last date of receipt of applications, i.e. on or before 30.03.2026. Further, the Ministry vide letter dated 20.09.2022 has issued the advisory in continuation to its earlier guidelines dated 26.09.2019 regarding filling up the HOD level posts in Major Port Authorities wherein it is inter-alia stated that, "In this connection, it is to clarified that certain documents viz.
  • obtaining vigilance clearance, APARs of the candidate may take some time due to administrative formalities. In such scenario, the ports need to forward the application of the officer with the approval of the competent authority (i.e through proper channel) to the port which has issued advertisement before due date of submission of application.
  • Such applications through proper channel (even through without APARs, Vigilance, etc.) will be taken into consideration by the Ministry for appointment to HOD level posts.
  • However, for consideration of candidature of the candidate by the Selection Committee, the Ports are required to forward the remaining documents without necessary delay.
  • At various instances, the Ports forward the applications of the candidates in the last hours.
  • Thus, it becomes impossible for the applications to reach the Port that issued advertisement before due date of submission. In such cases, the ports are required to forward his/her application (through proper channel i.e. forwarding of the Port alongwith printout of OAP application) via email so that the candidature of the candidate could be considered for the post. Subsequently, the complete application of the candidate alongwith other documents may be forwarded by the Port by registered Post to the Port that issued advertisement".
  • The crucial date of eligibility criteria will be the last date of closing of application i.e. 14.03.2026, in terms of Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways circular No. I-26/25/2013-PE-I dated 26.09.2019. If any major or minor penalty has been imposed on the applicant during the last 10 years, the disciplinary case leading to such penalty along with necessary documents may be sent by the forwarding authority along with the application.
  • Vigilance report is to be furnished in the format prescribed, vide Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterway's letter No.A-12023/2/2021-PE-1 dated 20.1.2021, copy of which is attached as Annexure-III.
  • As per the Ministry's guidelines dated 26.09.2019 regarding filling up the HOD level posts in Major Port Authorities, Port official, who withdraws his/her candidature for the post after his/her selection by the Services Selection Committee, will be liable for debarment from future selection to HOD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for a period of two years. Incomplete applications or applications not made following the stated procedure or received after due date will not be considered.

How to Apply

  • Applications are invited from eligible and willing Officers of all the Major Port Authorities possessing the prescribed qualifications, experience and other conditions, for the post of Secretary in the pay scale of Rs.100000-260000 as per Annexure-I. The application may be submitted through "Online Application Portal" (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways website https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in from 13.02.2026 to 14.03.2026. No application other than OAP shall be accepted.
  • The candidate will have to submit the printout of application form already uploaded in OAP to his administrative Port for onward forwarding. The administrative Ports are required to forward the applications of the candidates alongwith the following documents on or before 30.03.2026 superscribing "Application for the post of Secretary (HOD) in Mormugao Port Authority".
  • (i) Certified copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years (2020-21 to 2024-25), duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD on each of the pages.
  • (ii) A statement showing year-wise availability of ACRs/APARs and grading duly signed by the Dy. Chairperson/Chairperson as per the Ministry's letter dated 01.02.2007. If ACR/APAR for a particular year during the last 5 years period is pending/not available, "No Report Certificate" may be furnished alongwith ACRs/APARs of the preceding years.

  • (iv) No objection certificate from the respective Port.
  • (v) Certificate by the Head of the Office of the applicant (Annexure-II).
  • (vi) An undertaking of the applicant to the effect that candidature will not be withdrawn, if selected by Services Selection Committee.

  • (viii) The veracity of the professional certificates and caste certificate provided in terms of letter no.A-12022/10/2005-PE-I dated 27.8.2010 by the applicant may be ensured and certified.
  • (ix) Two recent passport size colour photographs in a sealed envelope.

KRCL Trainee Apprentices Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification (Passed 2021-2025)

  • Category I - Graduate Apprentices (Engineering): BE/BTech from AICTE-recognized university in Civil/ Electrical (or sub-streams)/ Electronics (or sub-streams)/ Mechanical (or sub-streams).
  • Category II - Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: Diploma from recognized board/university in Civil/ Electrical (or sub-streams)/ Electronics (or sub-streams)/ Mechanical (or sub-streams).
  • Category III - Graduate Apprentices (General Stream): BA/BSc/BCom/BBA/BMS/BJMC/BBS from UGC-recognized university.

Age Limit (As on 01.01.2026)

KRCL Trainee Apprentices Recruitment 2026

KRCL Trainee Apprentices Selection Process

Selection will be based on:

  1. Merit List: Aggregate percentage of all semesters/years (no rounding, no weightage per semester).
  2. Tie-Breaker: Older age, then earlier matriculation exam pass date.
  3. Shortlisting: 3 times the vacancies called for first round of Document Verification (DV); more if needed.
  4. Final medical fitness by KRCL.

No written exam or interview. Candidature cancelled if discrepancies found.

KRCL Trainee Apprentices Stipend

  • Graduate Apprentices: ₹9,000 per month (₹4,500 Govt share via DBT + ₹4,500 KRCL share).
  • Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: ₹8,000 per month (₹4,000 Govt share via DBT + ₹4,000 KRCL share).
  • No lodging/boarding provided; candidates arrange own.

Follow these steps:

  1. Register on NATS portal and get approved NATS ID.
  2. Visit KRCL website: https://konkanrailway.com.
  3. Go to Quick Links → Graduate Apprentice/Technician Apprentice.

Punjab Police Constable Selection Process 2026

The Punjab Police Constable Recruitment 2026 selection process consists of three stages:

Stage-I: Computer Based Test (CBT)

The CBT comprises two papers:

Paper-I (100 marks, 2 hours duration)

Section Topics Number of Questions
General Awareness Constitution, Central & State Legislature, History, Geography, Culture & Economy of Punjab, Health & Nutrition, Current Affairs 35
Quantitative Aptitude and Numerical Skills Simplification, Average, Decimal & Fractions, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Profit & Loss, Simple Interest, Time & Work 20
Mental Ability & Logical Reasoning Number & Letter Series, Sequencing, Statements & Conclusions, Pattern Completion, Order & Ranking, Direction & Distances, Relationship Problems 20
English Language Skills Reading Comprehension, Punjabi to English Translation, Sentence rearrangement & correction, Error Spotting, Fill in the Blanks, Spelling Correction, Vocabulary 10
Punjabi Language Skills ਸ਼ੁੱਧ/ਅਸ਼ੁੱਧ, ਸਮਾਨਾਰਥਕ/ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਸ਼ਬਦ, ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਅਖਾਣ ਅਤੇ ਮੁਹਾਵਰੇ, ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਤੋਂ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਅਨੁਵਾਦ, etc. 10

Total   100

  • Punjabi Language test of Matriculation standard
  • Qualifying criteria: 50% marks (25 out of 50)
  • Note: Marks obtained in Paper-II will NOT be counted for merit calculation

  • SC/BC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen: 35%
  • Other categories: 40%

  • No negative marking
  • Normalization will be applied as CBT conducted in multiple shifts
  • Answer key will be published after exam; candidates can raise objections within 48 hours (Rs. 50 per objection)

Candidates qualifying Paper-I and Paper-II will be shortlisted for Stage-II based on merit.

Candidate Category Physical Tests

Stage-III: Document Scrutiny

Candidates qualifying Stage-II will be called for document verification. Required documents include:

  • Matriculation certificate (proof of age)

  • Punjabi qualification proof
  • Domicile certificate (for female candidates applying under General category)

  • NOC (for serving government employees)
  • Photo identity proof (Aadhaar, Driving License, PAN, Voter ID, or Passport)

Note: Candidates unable to produce original documents will not be considered for selection.

Selection Process

    • Nativity Certificate.
    • Aadhaar Card.
    • Proof of enrollment/registration in the respective apprenticeship portal (NATS/NAPS).
  5. Email Submission: Send the scanned copy of duly filled application form affixed with passport size photograph along with all supporting documents to [email protected].
  6. Subject Line: Mention in email subject: “APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT OF APPRENTICES AGAINST NOTIFICATION NO. IREL/RED/HRM/Apprentices Engagement/2026-27/01”.

West Bengal.contentHtml:
CSIR – Central Mechanical Engineering Research Institute (CSIR CMERI) Project Staff Notification 2026 has been released on 2026 on the official website https://www.cmeri.res.in. A total of 42 vacancies have been announced through the CSIR CMERI Project Staff Recruitment 2026.

Candidates up to 35–40 years of age (depending on the post) who have Diploma / B.Sc / B.E / B.Tech / M.E / M.Tech / PhD / MBA / MSW or equivalent qualifications in relevant disciplines are eligible to apply for these Project Assistant, Project Associate, Project JRF, Project SRF, Senior Project Associate, Project Scientist and Project Research Scientist vacancies.

The walk-in interview process for CSIR CMERI Recruitment 2026 will be conducted on 16 March 2026 and 17 March 2026. Candidates can download the official notification PDF and attend the walk-in interview through the direct links provided below in this article.

CSIR CMERI Recruitment 2026 Overview – Basic Details

Advertisement

CSIR – Central Mechanical Engineering Research Institute (CSIR CMERI), Durgapur has invited applications for temporary project positions under various sponsored research projects.

  • Organization: CSIR – Central Mechanical Engineering Research Institute (CSIR CMERI), Durgapur
  • Advertisement Number: PRCT/01/2026
  • Recruitment Year: 2026
  • Total Vacancies: 42 (project staff posts)
  • Posts: Project Assistant, Project Associate, Project JRF, Project SRF, Senior Project Associate, Project Scientist, Project Research Scientist and other project personnel
  • Mode of Engagement: Walk-in Interview
  • Interview Location: CSIR CMERI, Mahatma Gandhi Avenue, Durgapur – 713209, West Bengal
  • Job Type: Temporary, project-based, co-terminous with project

The institute works in areas such as intelligent autonomous systems and robotics, digital manufacturing, smart farm machines, electric mobility, clean energy and hydrogen technologies, offering hands-on R&D exposure to young engineers and researchers.

Download CSIR CMERI Recruitment 2026 PDF

CSIR CMERI 2026 Vacancy Details – Check Post-wise Vacancies

Candidates can check the post-wise CSIR CMERI project staff vacancies for 2026 in the table below.

Post Name Indicative Post Codes Total Posts Project Tenure (Up to)
Project Assistant-II P-2609 to P-2615 (various projects) 42 30.06.2026 – 31.03.2028 (project-wise)
Project Associate-I P-2616 to P-2624 and others Up to 2026–2028 (project-wise)
Project Associate-II P-2627, P-2636, P-2637, P-2640 etc. Project-specific (up to 2027–2029)
Project JRF / Project SRF P-2625, P-2626, P-2629, P-2630 etc. Project-specific (up to 2027)
Senior Project Associate P-2628, P-2635, P-2638 to P-2644 etc. Project-specific (generally up to 2027)
Project Scientist / Project Research Scientist P-2628, P-2631, P-2632 etc. Project-specific (generally up to 2026–2027)

Exact distribution of the 42 vacancies by post code and discipline should be summarised in a detailed table directly mapped from the official advertisement.

CSIR CMERI Eligibility Criteria 2026 – Education, Age Limit and Experience

Educational Qualification

  • Project Assistant-II: 3-year Diploma in Engineering/Technology in relevant branches such as Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Agricultural, Manufacturing, Automobile, etc., OR B.Sc. in Physics/Chemistry for specific posts.
  • Project Associate-I: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering/Technology in relevant discipline (Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, Mechatronics, Aerospace, etc.) OR relevant Master’s degree in Physics/Electronics/Computer Science/Data Science as mentioned in the notification.
  • Project Associate-II: Same core B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech eligibility as Project Associate-I with minimum 2 years’ R&D experience in recognised institutions/industry, or higher qualification with required experience.
  • Project JRF / Project SRF: Relevant Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Engineering/Technology or Science with qualification in CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or equivalent national level examination; SRF requires at least 2 years of post-qualification research experience.
  • Senior Project Associate / Project Scientist / Project Research Scientist: B.E./B.Tech with 3–6 years’ R&D experience, or M.E./M.Tech with 2–4 years, or PhD in relevant engineering disciplines as specified for the concerned post code.

Desirable skills such as CAD/CAE (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, CATIA), ANSYS/Abaqus, MATLAB/Simulink, Python, machine learning, robotics, electric vehicles, hydrogen technology, and domain-specific software are highly preferred and can influence shortlisting.

Age Limit

  • Project Assistant / Project Associate (I & II) / Project JRF / Project Research Scientist: maximum 35 years.
  • Project SRF: maximum 32 years.
  • Senior Project Associate / Principal Project Associate / Project Scientist-I: maximum 40 years (some Scientist posts 35 years).
  • Age relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD/Women and 3 years for OBC candidates as per Government of India/CSIR rules.

Experience Requirements

  • Fresher-level posts: Many Project Assistant-II and Project Associate-I posts do not require prior experience, though exposure to tools/software is desirable.
  • Experienced posts: Project Associate-II, Senior Project Associate, Project Scientist and some Research Scientist posts require 2–6 years of relevant R&D experience in industrial/academic/scientific organisations.
  • Project-specific expertise: Experience in mechanical design and analysis, EV and power electronics, robotics, hydrogen systems, CFD, FEA, embedded systems, AI/ML, image/signal processing etc. is preferred as per post code.

CSIR CMERI Selection Process 2026 – Walk-in Interview and Assessment

The CSIR CMERI project staff selection process for 2026 is based on walk-in interviews only; there is no separate written examination.

  • Mode of Selection: Walk-in Interview at CSIR CMERI, Durgapur, as per scheduled dates and time.
  • Screening: Initial screening based on eligibility, educational qualification, experience and desirable skills mentioned for each post code.
  • Interview: Personal interview to assess subject knowledge, technical skills, research aptitude, project fit and communication skills.
  • Document Verification: Verification of original certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, identity and category certificates.
  • Final Merit: Final selection based on interview performance and overall suitability; results published on the CSIR CMERI website and/or communicated by email.

Since there is no written exam, there is no negative marking, question paper pattern or online test; candidates should prepare for an in-depth technical and project-oriented interaction.

How to Apply for CSIR CMERI Recruitment 2026 – Application Process and Important Dates

Application Process (Walk-in Mode)

  1. Visit the official CSIR CMERI website and go to the recruitment or career section.
  2. Download the prescribed Application Form for engagement of project staff against Advertisement No. PRCT/01/2026.
  3. Fill in personal details, educational qualifications, experience, and clearly mention the post code(s) and post name you are applying for.
  4. Attach self-attested photocopies of all required documents – age proof, mark sheets, degree/diploma certificates, experience certificates and category certificates (if applicable).
  5. Affix a recent passport size colour photograph in the space provided on the application form and carry additional photographs for use during the interview.
  6. Report at CSIR CMERI, Durgapur, on the scheduled date and time for your post code with the filled-in application form, original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies.
  7. No separate online application submission is required; there is no TA/DA for attending the walk-in interview.

Important Dates – CSIR CMERI Project Staff 2026

Event Date Details
Walk-in Interview – Day 1 16 March 2026 Interview for selected post codes (e.g., P-2609 to P-2615 and other groups) – reporting time as per official schedule.
Walk-in Interview – Day 2 17 March 2026 Interview for remaining post codes in other groups – candidates must check exact reporting time in the notice.

Candidates are advised to reach the venue well before the reporting time and plan for possible delays, as the interview process can extend till late evening.

CSIR CMERI Salary 2026 – Pay Scale and Job Profile

Monthly Salary / Fellowship

Post Category Monthly Salary (Consolidated)
Project Assistant-II Rs. 20,000/- per month with 15% increment after 3 years of experience in the same project
Project Associate-I Rs. 25,000/- per month OR Rs. 31,000/- per month for candidates with NET/GATE or approved national exam
Project Associate-II Rs. 28,000/- per month OR Rs. 35,000/- per month for candidates with NET/GATE or approved national exam
Project JRF Generally in the range of Rs. 31,000–37,000/- per month as per project norms
Project SRF Rs. 42,000/- per month
Senior Project Associate Rs. 42,000/- per month
Project Scientist-I / Project Research Scientist-I Rs. 56,000/- per month (project-based)

These are consolidated project fellowships and do not correspond to regular CSIR permanent pay scales; the engagement is purely temporary and restricted to the sanctioned project duration and overall CSIR project service limits.

CSIR CMERI Recruitment 2026 – Important Rules and General Conditions

  • The engagement is purely temporary and project-based; it does not confer any right to claim permanent CSIR/CMERI appointment.
  • The tenure of each position is co-terminous with the respective project or up to the maximum permissible project engagement period in CSIR, whichever is earlier.
  • Actual number of positions may increase or decrease on the date of interview depending on project requirements.
  • Candidates who have already completed or will complete 6 years of engagement in CSIR projects (as trainee, project assistant, fellow, JRF, SRF, associate, etc.) will not be considered beyond the 6-year limit.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview.
  • Candidates working in CSIR projects or other organisations must bring a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their present employer/competent authority.
  • The decision of the competent authority of CSIR CMERI in all matters related to eligibility, selection and engagement will be final and binding.

Document Verification Date To be intimated on registered email ID / IOCL website
Cutoff / Reckoning Date (Age & Qualification) 28/02/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates must register successfully on NAPS/NATS portal and apply against the notification to be considered for the selection process.
  • There will be no written test or interview.
  • A merit list will be prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential prescribed qualification for the respective post.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification.
  • Shortlisted candidates must complete a Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test and be adjudged medically fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical format.
  • Candidates whose documents and Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Certificate are found in order shall be issued an Offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training.
  • Opportunities not filled through the initial shortlisting shall be filled by eligible candidates from the merit cum panel list for the same opportunity.

General Information / Instructions

  • Candidates must apply only for ONE discipline code. Applications for more than one discipline code will be summarily rejected.
  • Applicants must submit applications only against vacancies notified under the states of Western Region (Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, UT of Daman & Diu, UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli). Selection of training locations outside notified states will result in rejection.
  • Candidate profile on the portal must be 100% complete (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category, etc.).
  • The candidature of the applicant shall be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates and testimonials.
  • Any false or incorrect information furnished at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature and liability for criminal prosecution.
  • Candidates should maintain the same registered email ID and mobile number till completion of apprenticeship training.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats shall be considered subject to fulfilling standards applicable to General category candidates.

  • After registration, login to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using your User ID/Email ID and APPLY for apprenticeship openings using the following Establishment IDs of IOCL (Marketing Division) – Western Region:
    • NATS Establishment ID: WMHMCC000053
    • NAPS Establishment ID: E01172700332
  • Application window: 11.03.2026 (10:00 AM) to 26.03.2026 (5:00 PM).
  • No other means or mode of application will be accepted.

No separate application is required for Mumbai Division and Headquarters Office.

Applicants must be in possession of an Aadhaar Card. At the time of registration, they are required to enter their 12-digit Aadhaar number. This provision is applicable to applicants from all States and Union Territories. At the time of Document Verification, applicants are required to produce their original Aadhaar Card.

Applicants must ensure that their name, father's name, and date of birth exactly match the details recorded in their Matriculation or equivalent certificate. Any discrepancy found during Document Verification may result in cancellation of candidature and also debarment.

Applicants are advised to provide their active mobile number and valid email ID in the online application and ensure that both remain operational throughout the entire engagement process. All important notifications will be published on the official website, and email/SMS communications will be sent only to the selected applicants. Such communications shall be deemed to have been read by the applicants.

Applicants are permitted to choose only one Division/Workshop. The option once exercised shall be final and binding on the applicant. Applicants are advised to carefully refer to the trade-wise vacancy table (Annexure A) to verify the vacancies notified and ensure that the Division/Workshop they wish to apply for has available vacancies corresponding to their trade, qualification, community, and category.

Applicants possessing ITI qualifications in more than one trade may apply separately for each relevant trade.

Applicants attempting to submit more than one application for the same trade using different particulars such as Name, Father’s Name, Community, PWD status, educational and/or technical qualifications, or different Email IDs/Mobile Numbers are hereby informed that all such applications will be summarily rejected.

Applicants are required to download and retain a printout of their online application, which must be produced whenever requested by the Railway Administration.

Applicants are required to report for Document/Certificate Verification with their original documents, along with the Medical Fitness Certificate (Annexure-G), at the designated Division/Workshop/Unit.

Applicants claiming consideration under the EWS quota are required to upload their EWS Certificate, as specified in Para 2.7.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates must be Indian nationals with consistently good academic record.
  • Only those who have successfully cleared and possess valid certificate for at least one of the following national level examinations are eligible: UGC-CSIR-NET Fellowship (SLET/Lectureship not eligible), JEST, ICMR-JRF Test, ICAR-JRF Test, DBT-JRF Biotechnology Eligibility Test, GATE in Physics/Chemistry/Life Sciences/Biotechnology, or JGEEBILS.

  • Candidates with five years Integrated M.Sc./B.S-M.S. (Dual degree) should have secured minimum 55% aggregate.
  • Candidates having a 4-year / 8-semester bachelor’s degree (B.S with fourth year Research) with minimum 75% marks in aggregate are also eligible to apply.
  • Candidates who have completed but are awaiting final results of M.Sc., Integrated M.Sc., B.S-M.S. (Dual degree) or B.S. (with fourth year Research) may also apply, subject to specified minimum aggregates up to the previous semester and completion of degree requirements before 10-08-2026.

  • M.Sc. / Integrated M.Sc. / B.S-M.S. (Dual degree) / B.S. (with fourth year Research) in Life Sciences disciplines (including Life Science, Botany, Zoology, Agriculture, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Marine Biology, Bioinformatics, Genetics, Plant Science, Plant Breeding, Plant Pathology, Entomology, Animal Science, Biomedical Sciences, Biosciences, Food Science, Food Science and Technology) with Physics or Chemistry or Biochemistry or Agriculture Chemistry or allied Chemistry as one of the subjects at B.Sc./five-year integrated M.Sc. level is eligible.
  • Candidates with specializations listed as not eligible in Physics, Chemistry and Life Sciences (such as Electronics and Instrumentation, Industrial Chemistry, Polymer Chemistry, Textile Chemistry, Environmental Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Petroleum Chemistry, Nanoscience, Nanotechnology, Fisheries, Horticulture, Forestry, Agronomy, Animal Husbandry, Bio-analytical Sciences, Polymer Science, Medicine/Medical Science, Pharmaceutical Science, Home Science, and B.Tech./M.Tech. in Life Sciences disciplines) are not eligible.

  • Mode of payment of the application fee is online only, using net banking, debit card, credit card, UPI, etc.
  • Application fee is exempted for Women candidates and candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and Person with Benchmark Disabilities.
  • After submission of the online application, the applicant has to make online payment of application fee using the Application Number generated; applications without fee payment will be treated as incomplete and rejected.

e-Admit Card Download Date Last working day of preceding week of examination date
Physical Standards Tests / Physical Efficiency Tests After declaration of Written Exam result

Medical Standards Tests After Interview / Personality Test

Selection Process

  • Stage 1: Written Examination (19th July, 2026)
    • Paper-I: General Ability and Intelligence - 250 Marks
      • Duration: 2 hours (10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon)
      • Type: Objective (Multiple Choice) Type questions
      • Medium: English as well as Hindi
      • Subjects: General Mental Ability (logical reasoning, quantitative aptitude, numerical ability, data interpretation), General Science, Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Polity & Economy, History of India, Indian & World Geography
      • There will be penalty (Negative Marking) for wrong answers: One third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for each wrong answer
    • Paper-II: General Studies, Essay and Comprehension - 200 Marks
      • Duration: 3 hours (2:00 PM to 5:00 PM)
      • Type: Conventional (Descriptive) Type
      • Part-A: Essay questions (80 Marks) - to be answered in long narrative form either in Hindi or English. Topics: modern Indian history especially freedom struggle, geography, polity and economy, security and human rights issues, analytical ability
      • Part-B: Comprehension, précis writing, other communications/language skills (120 Marks) - to be attempted in English only. Topics: Comprehension passages, précis writing, developing counter arguments, simple grammar and other language testing aspects
      • Candidates must write answers only in the medium allowed. No credit for answers written in other medium
    • There will be minimum qualifying marks separately in each Paper as may be fixed by the Commission
    • Paper-I will be evaluated first and Paper-II will be evaluated only for those who obtain minimum qualifying marks in Paper-I
  • Stage 2: Physical Standards Tests (PST) / Physical Efficiency Tests (PET)
    • Conducted for candidates qualified in Written Examination
    • Physical Standards Requirements:
      • Men: Height 165 cm, Chest 81 cm (unexpanded) with 5 cm minimum expansion, Weight 50 kg
      • Women: Height 157 cm, Weight 46 kg
      • Height and chest measurement will be measured correct to one decimal in centimeter
      • Weight should be as per height and age as per prescribed chart
    • Physical Efficiency Tests:
      • Men: 100 Meter Race in 16 Seconds, 800 Meter Race in 3 Min 45 Sec, Long Jump 3.5 Meters (3 Chances), Shot Put (7.26 Kg) 4.5 Meters (3 Chances)
      • Women: 100 Meter Race in 18 Seconds, 800 Meter Race in 4 Min 45 Sec, Long Jump 3.0 Meters (3 Chances)
    • Female candidates must submit self-declaration about pregnancy status before PST/PET
    • Conducted under supervision of Nodal Authority appointed by Ministry of Home Affairs
  • Stage 3: Interview / Personality Test
    • Only for candidates qualified in PST/PET
    • Marks: 150 Marks
    • Conducted by Union Public Service Commission
    • Candidates declared unqualified in PET will not be called for Interview
    • NCC 'B' or 'C' Certificate holders will be given consideration at Interview stage
  • Stage 4: Medical Standards Tests (MST)
    • Conducted only for candidates who appeared in Interview/Personality Test
    • Detailed Medical Standards prescribed for Eye Sight, Ear, Nose, Neck, Teeth, General Health, etc.
    • Eye Sight: Better eye 6/6 or 6/9 (corrected), Worse eye 6/12 or 6/9 (corrected), Near Vision N6/N9 (corrected), Colour Perception CP-III by ISIHARA plates
    • LASIK surgery correction permitted subject to prescribed criteria
    • Candidates declared 'UNFIT' can appear before Review Medical Board preferably next day of DME
    • Appeals against MST results must be made within 24 hours after declaration of DME results
    • Conducted under supervision of Nodal Authority appointed by Ministry of Home Affairs
  • Final Selection/Merit:
    • Merit list drawn on basis of marks obtained in Written Examination and Interview/Personality Test
    • Any candidate found not satisfying prescribed Medical Standards after MST will not be appointed
    • Tie Breaking Principle: (i) Higher marks in written total, (ii) Higher marks in Paper-I, (iii) Senior in age, (iv) At Commission's discretion

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply online only using the Commission's website: https://upsconline.nic.in
  • No other mode is allowed for submission of application
  • Application Process has Four Modules:
    • Module 1: Account Creation - Can be filled anytime (common for all exams)
    • Module 2: Universal Registration (URN) - Can be filled anytime (common for all exams). URN generated is unique and remains constant for all UPSC exams
    • Module 3: Common Application Form (CAF) - Can be filled anytime (common for all exams)
    • Module 4: Examination Specific Module - Can be filled only during notification period (includes fees, centres, force preferences, etc.)
  • Documents Required:
    • Recent passport-size colour photograph (scanned in .jpg format, 20 KB to 200 KB)
    • Signature (scanned - sign three times one below other on plain white paper using black ink, .jpg format, 20 KB to 100 KB)
    • Live photograph (to be captured while filling CAF)
    • One Photo ID Card details (Aadhaar/Voter/PAN/Passport/Driving License/Any other Government Photo ID)
    • Date of Birth certificate (Matriculation/Secondary School Leaving Certificate)
    • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
    • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) in prescribed format, if applicable
    • OBC candidates: OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate based on income for FY 2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23, issued on/after 01.04.2025 but not later than 12.03.2026

Selection Process

  • Computer Based Test (CBT): Consists of objective questions (subjective as well for Legal HR Officers) and comprises two parts:
    • Part I – General Aptitude: English Language, Quantitative Aptitude Test & Intellectual Potential Test (Logical Reasoning and Data Interpretation).
    • Part II – Technical / Professional Knowledge: Questions related to qualifying degree / educational background required for the applied position.
  • CBT will be conducted tentatively on 3rd May 2026. HPCL reserves the right to reschedule the date of CBT.
  • Questions will be based on syllabus hosted on Careers Page on corporate website (indicative, not exhaustive).
  • Candidates qualifying in CBT, in order of merit and predetermined ratio, will be advised to upload supporting documents for certain positions.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Group Task and/or Personal Interview based on scrutiny of application, uploaded documents, and merit list.
  • Candidates' document verification shall be conducted before Personal Interviews.
  • Candidates may be required to undergo Psychometric Assessments before/after Group Task/Personal Interview.
  • Candidates must secure minimum qualifying marks in each applicable selection stage (CBT, Group Task, and Personal Interview) to be considered for further selection.
  • A category and discipline-wise merit list will be drawn for all candidates who qualify in all applicable stages.
  • The selected candidates would be required to join HPCL as per the date of joining mentioned in the Offer of Appointment.

General Information / Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • All computations of age / relevant experience / qualification shall be done with respect to the last date of receipt of online application i.e. 25th March 2026.
  • All qualifications should be full-time regular courses from AICTE approved / UGC recognized University / Deemed University.
  • Teaching & Research experience in an academic institute will not be considered as relevant work experience.
  • Candidates currently employed at HPCL are not eligible to apply for Lateral Positions (positions where minimum experience is sought).
  • Selected candidates will be on Probation for one year from the Date of Joining.
  • Selected candidates will have to execute a service bond to serve the corporation for a minimum period of three years. Bond Amount: General – ₹3,00,000/-; EWS/OBC(NC)/SC/ST/PwBD – ₹50,000/-.
  • A Retention Amount of ₹5,000/- per month will be deducted for Pay Scales ₹30,000–1,20,000 or ₹40,000–1,40,000 during the first 12 months of probation.
  • A Retention Amount of ₹8,000/- per month will be deducted for Pay Scales from ₹50,000–1,60,000 till ₹90,000–2,40,000 during the first 12 months of probation.
  • Appointment is subject to candidate being medically fit as per standards prescribed by the Corporation.
  • Candidates would be required to clear Physical Fitness Efficiency Test (PFET) comprising Working at Height Test, Endurance Test, and Agility Test after PEME (wherever applicable).
  • Depending upon the requirement of the Corporation, selected candidates can be placed anywhere in India or overseas at the discretion of the Management.
  • Maximum upper age of applicants shall not exceed 56 years including all possible age relaxations.
  • Court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Mumbai.
  • Any further corrigendum / addendum would be uploaded only on www.hindustanpetroleum.com.

  • Online Application will be accepted from 1300 hrs on 25th February 2026 till 2359 hrs on 25th March 2026.
  • Candidates are requested to apply online only at www.hindustanpetroleum.com → Careers → Current Openings, after reading the detailed advertisement.
  • No other means / mode of application shall be accepted.
  • Applications with incomplete / wrong particulars or not in the prescribed format will not be considered.
  • The email ID and mobile number provided in the online application should remain valid for at least one year. Applications with pseudo / fake email IDs will attract appropriate action under the law.
  • Upload the photograph and signature of the candidate during application. In case of wrong / missing photo / signature, the candidature will be cancelled.
  • All details given in the online form will be treated as final and no changes will be entertained.
  • Pay the applicable application fee online via Debit Card / Credit Card / UPI / Net Banking and ensure the payment status shows "Completed". Take a printout of the acknowledgment of payment for future reference.
  • Queries must be emailed with subject formatted as "Position Name – Application Number" at [email protected].
  • Candidates are advised to apply online well before the closing date and not wait till the last date.
  • Candidates currently employed in Government Departments / PSUs / Autonomous Bodies must submit their application through proper process and produce No Objection Certificate at the time of Personal Interview.

Educational Qualification (Passed 2021-2025)

  • Category I - Graduate Apprentices (Engineering): BE/BTech from AICTE-recognized university in Civil/ Electrical (or sub-streams)/ Electronics (or sub-streams)/ Mechanical (or sub-streams).
  • Category II - Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: Diploma from recognized board/university in Civil/ Electrical (or sub-streams)/ Electronics (or sub-streams)/ Mechanical (or sub-streams).
  • Category III - Graduate Apprentices (General Stream): BA/BSc/BCom/BBA/BMS/BJMC/BBS from UGC-recognized university.

Age Limit (As on 01.01.2026)

KRCL Trainee Apprentices Recruitment 2026

  1. Merit List: Aggregate percentage of all semesters/years (no rounding, no weightage per semester).
  2. Tie-Breaker: Older age, then earlier matriculation exam pass date.
  3. Shortlisting: 3 times the vacancies called for first round of Document Verification (DV); more if needed.
  4. Final medical fitness by KRCL.

No written exam or interview. Candidature cancelled if discrepancies found.

  • No lodging/boarding provided; candidates arrange own.

  1. Register on NATS portal and get approved NATS ID.
  2. Visit KRCL website: https://konkanrailway.com.
  3. Go to Quick Links → Graduate Apprentice/Technician Apprentice.
  4. Read notification and fill online application form (keep email/mobile active).

  7. Submit and print confirmation (no hard copy to send).
  8. Shortlisted candidates appear for DV with originals and photocopies.

  • Apply for correct slot based on qualification; wrong slot leads to rejection.
  • No TA/DA for DV.
  • Keep Aadhaar-linked bank account and PAN for stipend.

Total 78

Eligibility Criteria

Dean:

  • An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant and discipline, published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with, a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per the criteria given in Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC Regulation 2018.
  • A minimum of fifteen years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and / or research experience at equivalent level at University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided the doctoral candidate

Professor:

  • An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer- reviewed International Web of Science, Scopus indexed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per the criteria given in Appendix II, Table 2 of Government of Maharashtra's Higher & Technical Education Department's 7 Pay Commission Government Resolution No. Misc- 2018/C.R.56/18/UNI-1, dated 8th March, 2019 and Corrigendum dated 10th May 2019.
  • A minimum of Ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor / Associate Professor / Professor, and / or research experience at equivalent level at the University / National / International Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate. OR
  •  An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant / allied / applied disciplines, from any National / International academic institutions, (not included in 'A' above) / industry who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he / she has ten years experience

Assistant Professor:

  • A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed) in a concerned / relevant / allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university by vide UGC circular. AND
  • National Eligibility Test (NET), State Eligibility Test (SET) and State Level Eligibility Test (SLET) will be the minimum criteria for the direct recruitment to the post of Assistant Professor for all higher education institutions.

Associate Professor:

  • A good academic record with a Ph.D. degree in the concerned / allied / relevant disciplines; A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade ina point- scale, wherever the grading system is followed); and A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and / or research in an academic / research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research National /International Institution / industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC- listed journals and a total research score of 75 as per the criteria given in Appendix II, Table 2 of Government of Maharashtra's Higher & Technical Education Department's 7 PayCommission Government Resolution No. Misc- 2018/C.R.56/18/UNI- 1, dated 8th March, 2019 and Corrigendum dated 10th May 2019.

Director:

  • A Master's Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in point-scale, wherever grading system is followed;
  • At least ten years as a Librarian at any level in University Library or ten years of teaching as Assistant/Associate Professor in Library Science or ten years' experience as a College Librarian;
  • Evidence of innovative library services, including the integration of ICT in a library; and
  • A Ph.D. Degree in Library Science / Information Science / Documentation Science / Archives and manuscript-keeping.

Applications not filled in correctly, incomplete or not as per the instructions are liable to be rejected and the responsibility of such rejection will be on the candidate himself/herself.

On completion of online application, candidate should take complete printout of the application and submit a Hard Copy in Two sets and completed in all respects, along with synopsis and necessary documents duly self-attested. KRCL Trainee Apprentices Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification (Passed 2021-2025)

  • Category I - Graduate Apprentices (Engineering): BE/BTech from AICTE-recognized university in Civil/ Electrical (or sub-streams)/ Electronics (or sub-streams)/ Mechanical (or sub-streams).

  1. Merit List: Aggregate percentage of all semesters/years (no rounding, no weightage per semester).
  2. Tie-Breaker: Older age, then earlier matriculation exam pass date.
  3. Shortlisting: 3 times the vacancies called for first round of Document Verification (DV); more if needed.
  4. Final medical fitness by KRCL.

No written exam or interview. Candidature cancelled if discrepancies found.

  • No lodging/boarding provided; candidates arrange own.

  1. Register on NATS portal and get approved NATS ID.
  2. Visit KRCL website: https://konkanrailway.com.
  3. Go to Quick Links → Graduate Apprentice/Technician Apprentice.
  4. Read notification and fill online application form (keep email/mobile active).
  5. Upload photo and signature (mandatory).
  6. Pay processing fee online: ₹100 (General/OBC-NCL/EWS), Nil (SC/ST/Female/Minorities).
  7. Submit and print confirmation (no hard copy to send).
  8. Shortlisted candidates appear for DV with originals and photocopies.

Important Notes:

  • Apply for correct slot based on qualification; wrong slot leads to rejection.
  • No TA/DA for DV.
  • Keep Aadhaar-linked bank account and PAN for stipend.

Rail Wheel Factory (RWF) Act Apprentice Notification 2026 has been released on 28/02/2026 on the official website https://rwf.indianrailways.gov.in. A total of 192 vacancies have been announced through the RWF Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026.

Candidates aged 15 to 24 years (as on 01/03/2026) who have passed 10th class with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks and possess a National Trade Certificate (NTC) issued by NCVT in the relevant trade are eligible to apply for these Act Apprentice vacancies. The application process for RWF Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is offline and applications must be submitted before 01/04/2026 (before 17:00 hrs).

Candidates can download the official notification PDF and application form from the official website and submit the completed form either through Registered Post or by dropping it in the designated drop box at Rail Wheel Factory, Yelahanka, Bengaluru, before the last date.

Note: The above vacancies are tentative and the administration reserves the right to modify them. Seats of PwBD and Ex-Servicemen are included in the total and not separate.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Minimum Educational Qualification: Candidates must have passed the 10th class examination or its equivalent with a minimum of 50% (aggregate) marks from recognized Boards, as on the date of issue of Notification.
  • Technical Qualification: Candidates must also possess a National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the designated trade in which this administration is imparting training, issued by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT). Mere completion of a course is not sufficient.
  • Note: Candidates who are awaiting results pertaining to ITI/NTC as on the date of this Notification are NOT eligible to apply. Candidates who have failed in ITI/NTC should not apply.
  • Higher Qualification: Engineering Graduates and Diploma Holders are NOT ELIGIBLE to apply for undergoing Apprenticeship Training in response to this Notification, as they are governed by a separate scheme of Apprenticeship.
  • Employment Exchange Registration (Mandatory): The candidates who have registered their names with the local Employment Exchanges are only eligible to apply. The registration should be current and valid as on the date of issue of this Notification. Preference will be given to those candidates who have registered in Employment Exchanges within the jurisdiction of State of Karnataka.
  • Wards of Serving Railway Employees: Wards of Serving Railway employees all over the Indian Railways are also eligible to apply. Serving Railway employees should ensure that the applications of their wards are sent through their respective Controlling Officials in the prescribed proforma as per Annexure-D. Registration of names of their wards with Employment Exchanges is not necessary for this category.
  • Only full-time regular courses will be considered. All minimum essential qualifications must be from recognized Boards / NCVT.

The Act Apprentices imparted training in Railway establishments will have no claim to seek employment on Railways on the basis of such training.

Age Limit (as on 01-03-2026)

  • The candidate should have completed 15 years of age and should not have completed 24 years of age as on 01.03.2026 (i.e. date of issue of Notification).
  • Age Relaxation:
    • SC / ST candidates: Upper age limit relaxable by 5 years
    • OBC candidates: Upper age limit relaxable by 3 years
    • Age relaxation as per extant instructions of Railway Board and as amended from time to time.
  • Candidates who want to avail the benefit of reservation of SC/ST must produce his/her caste certificate on Govt. of India format issued by appropriate authority as per Annexure-B.
  • Candidates who want to avail the benefit of reservation of OBC must produce caste certificate and Non-Creamy Layer Certificate issued on or after 01.07.2025 on Govt. of India format as per Annexure-C.

Application Fee

  • Application Fee: ₹100/- (One Hundred only) as processing fee in the form of an Indian Postal Order (IPO) / Demand Draft from any Nationalised Bank, drawn in favour of 'Principal Financial Adviser / Rail Wheel Factory'.
  • Exempted Categories: No fee is required to be paid by SC / ST / Physically Handicapped / Women candidates.
  • Applications not accompanied with the processing fee, wherever required, will be summarily rejected.
  • The IPO/DD instruments should not have been issued earlier to the date of issue of this Notification (28.02.2026).
  • The processing fee is non-refundable.

Training Period

  • Fitter, Machinist, Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), Turner, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic: Training period is One Year.
  • CNC Programming cum-Operator (COE Group): Training period is Six Months.
  • Training will be arranged in accordance with the standards and syllabus prescribed by the Central Apprenticeship Council.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 28/02/2026
Last Date for Submission of Application 01/04/2026 (Before 17:00 hrs)
Probable Date of Display of List of Selected Candidates 45 days from the closing date of receipt of applications
Tentative Date of Commencement of Training 15 days after issue of merit list

Selection Process

  • The selection of candidates will be made on the basis of merit list prepared based on the percentage of marks obtained by the candidate in 10th Std / Matriculation or its equivalent with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks.
  • For the purpose of calculation of percentage of marks in 10th Std, marks obtained by the candidates in all the subjects as indicated in the said marks sheet will be reckoned and not on the basis of marks of any subject or a group of subjects.
  • Tie-breaking Rule: In case of two candidates having the same marks, the candidate with older age shall be preferred. In case dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed the 10th Std / Matriculation or its equivalent examination earlier shall be considered first.
  • A final merit list would be prepared equal to the number of designated trades proposed to be filled up, duly ensuring reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PH/Ex-Servicemen candidates, in descending order of percentage of marks obtained.
  • Candidates finally enlisted to undergo training would be subjected to verification of original testimonials.
  • Medical Fitness: Candidates must satisfy minimum standards of physical fitness as prescribed in the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 as amended from time to time. The selected candidates will have to submit a prescribed medical examination certificate in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-E) before their engagement. Physical fitness will be certified by a government authorized Doctor (Gazetted) not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon of Central/State Hospital.

General Information / Instructions

  • Rail Wheel Factory Administration is the nodal agency for processing of applications from candidates and preparation of their merit list.
  • Before commencement of the Apprenticeship training, selected candidates have to execute a Contract of Apprenticeship with the Employer. If the candidate is a Minor, then his/her guardian has to enter into a contract of Apprenticeship with the Employer.
  • Selected candidates are required to register the contract of Apprenticeship in online mode at the Apprenticeship portal: https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/candidate-login. Candidates are advised to register at the earliest without waiting for the final select list to be published.
  • On completion of training, the candidate, on passing a test to be conducted by NCVT in Vocational Trades, will be given a certificate of proficiency in the trade by the National Council.
  • Candidates should ensure that their Name, Father's/Mother's name/Guardian's name and Date of Birth in the application form exactly match as recorded in their Matriculation or equivalent certificates and other certificates including Aadhaar certificates. Any deviation found during document verification will lead to cancellation of candidature and debarment from undergoing training.
  • Reservation and age relaxation for various categories/communities is as per the Govt. of India Rules for the purpose and as revised by the Railway Board from time to time.
  • Candidates employed in Government / Quasi-Government / PSU should send their application through proper channel.
  • Candidates will have no claim to seek employment on Railways on the basis of such training as per the Apprentices Act, 1961.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • No Hostel facility will be provided. The selected candidates should make their own arrangements for their stay during their period of training.
  • The candidates attending the office for verification of documents will not be paid any TA/DA.
  • The caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC) should be in the form notified by the Government of India. If the caste certified by the candidate does not appear in the Central Gazette, then he/she will be treated as belonging to 'UR' community.
  • The applicant should submit only one application form. Multiple applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates are required to furnish the correct and complete postal address with Pin Code in their application.
  • The list of selected candidates will be displayed at https://rwf.indianrailways.gov.in. Important messages will be sent by SMS/E-mail.
  • Help Desk: For any queries related to the submission of applications, candidates can call on 080-28072616 from 09:00 hrs. to 16:50 hrs. (Monday to Friday) on all working days and from 09:00 hrs. to 12:20 hrs. on Saturday (except Sundays and Holidays).

Documents Required (Self-Attested Photocopies)

  • 10th Std / Matriculation or its equivalent marks certificate with at least 50% marks, with Date of Birth as proof of age.
  • National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the designated trade issued by NCVT.
  • Copy of caste certificate (SC/ST candidates in proforma Annexure-B and OBC candidates in proforma Annexure-C).
  • Physically Handicapped / Disability certificate duly issued by the competent medical board.
  • Two identical passport size photographs duly self-attested and firmly stitched in a separate cover to the application form (apart from one copy pasted on the application form).
  • Discharge certificate / serving certificate for wards of Ex-Servicemen / serving Railway employee.
  • Employment Registration card, registered in Employment Exchanges within the State of Karnataka (for Karnataka candidates) or respective local employment exchanges (for other state candidates), with renewal being current.
  • Wards of serving Railway employees should produce a certificate issued by the respective controlling officers in proforma Annexure-D.
  • IPO / Demand Draft of ₹100/- as processing fee (where applicable).

How to Apply

  • Download the Application Form (Annexure-A) and all other Annexures (B, C, D & E) from the official website of Rail Wheel Factory: https://rwf.indianrailways.gov.in. No other format shall be entertained.
  • Fill the application form carefully. Ensure that Name, Father's/Mother's/Guardian's name and Date of Birth exactly match as recorded in Matriculation and other certificates. Any deviation will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Affix a recent colour passport size photograph duly signed/attested by the candidate on the application form.
  • Enclose all required self-attested documents including 10th marks sheet, NTC, caste certificate, Employment Exchange registration card, photographs and IPO/DD as applicable.
  • Fill and sign the checklist in Annexure-F. Applications submitted without duly filled in checklist and signed by the candidate will not be considered.
  • The application (Annexure-A) can either be dropped in the sealed Drop Box kept in the Office of the Principal Chief Personnel Officer, Personnel Department, Rail Wheel Factory, Yelahanka, Bangalore-560064 on all working days (Monday to Friday: 09:00 hrs to 16:50 hrs; Saturday: 09:00 hrs to 12:20 hrs).
  • Alternatively, the application can be sent by REGISTERED POST ONLY to the below address, superscribing on the cover as "Application for undergoing training under the Apprentices' Act, 1961 for the year 2025-26 in Rail Wheel Factory":
    The Senior Personnel Officer-II, Personnel Department, Rail Wheel Factory, Yelahanka, Bangalore – 560 064.
  • Applications should be submitted to this office before 17:00 hrs. of the closing date i.e., 01.04.2026. Applications received after the closing date will not be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Candidates are advised to submit applications well in advance before the closing date to avoid last minute rush.

Selection Process

  • Candidates must register successfully on NAPS/NATS portal and apply against the notification to be considered for the selection process.
  • There will be no written test or interview.
  • A merit list will be prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential prescribed qualification for the respective post.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification.
  • Shortlisted candidates must complete a Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test and be adjudged medically fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical format.
  • Candidates whose documents and Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Certificate are found in order shall be issued an Offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training.
  • Opportunities not filled through the initial shortlisting shall be filled by eligible candidates from the merit cum panel list for the same opportunity.

  • Canvassing of any kind shall disqualify the candidate.

  • After registration, login to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using your User ID/Email ID and APPLY for apprenticeship openings using the following Establishment IDs of IOCL (Marketing Division) – Western Region:
    • NATS Establishment ID: WMHMCC000053
    • NAPS Establishment ID: E01172700332
  • Application window: 11.03.2026 (10:00 AM) to 26.03.2026 (5:00 PM).
  • No other means or mode of application will be accepted.
  • Ensure your profile is 100% complete with Personal Details, Educational Details, and Category before applying.
  • Before applying, keep ready: PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account details with Cheque Book (name printed), and scanned copies of Educational Qualification Certificates.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well in advance before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.
  • Candidates registered with Local/State Employment Exchange(s) / Vocational Rehabilitation Centre for PwBD and meeting prescribed eligibility criteria must apply through NAPS/NATS Portal.
