NFSU Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification and Experience (Summarized; refer to notification for full details)

  • Deputy Director (Cyber Security/Cyber Defence): PhD/Master's/BE/BTech in relevant fields + 7/10/12 years experience. Age: ≤50 years.
  • Deputy Director (Forensic Psychology): PhD/Master's in Psychology/Criminology + 7/10 years experience. Age: ≤50 years.
  • Assistant Director (NDPS): PhD/Master's in Forensic Science/Chemistry + 4/7 years experience. Age: ≤45 years.
  • Senior Scientific Officer (Cyber Security/Cyber Defence): PhD/Master's/BE/BTech in relevant fields + 2/5/7 years experience. Age: ≤40 years.
  • Senior Scientific Officer (NDPS): PhD/Master's in Forensic Science/Chemistry + 2/5 years experience. Age: ≤40 years.
  • Junior Scientific Officer (Ballistics): Master's in Forensic Science/Physics + 3 years experience. Age: ≤35 years.
  • Junior Scientific Officer (Forensic Accounting): Master's in Accounting/Finance or CA/ICWA + 3 years experience. Age: ≤35 years.
  • Laboratory Assistant: Bachelor's in Forensic Science/Sciences. Age: 18-27 years.
  • Section Officer/Deputy Section Officer: Bachelor's in any discipline with good academic record + knowledge of Hindi/English/Computers. Age: 21-40 years.
  • Assistant: Bachelor's in any discipline + knowledge of Hindi/English/Computers. Age: 21-35 years.

Age Limit

  • Deputy Director - Cyber Security/Cyber Defence: Not be more than 50 years of age
  • Deputy Director - Forensic Psychology: Not be more than 50 years of age
  • Assistant Director - NDPS: Not be more than 45 years of age
  • Senior Scientific Officer - Cyber Security/Cyber Defence: Not be more than 40 years of age
  • Senior Scientific Officer - NDPS: Not be more than 40 years of age
  • Junior Scientific Officer - Ballistics: Not be more than 40 years of age
  • Junior Scientific Officer - Forensic Accounting: Not be more than 35 years of age
  • Laboratory Assistant: Not be less than 18 Years and more than 27 Years of Age
  • Section Officer: Not be less than 21 years and more than 40 Years of age
  • Deputy Section Officer: Not be less than 21 years and more than 40 Years of age
  • Assistant: Not be less than 21 years and more than 35 Years of age
  • Varies by post (as above); relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex-servicemen/Govt. servants as per GoI rules. No upper age limit for current Central/State Govt./University employees.

Additional Requirements

  • Indian nationals only.
  • Good academic record (≥55% or equivalent where applicable).
  • Relevant certifications/experience desirable for some posts.
  • Must meet minimum experience in govt./recognized labs/industry.

NFSU Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • For Deputy/Assistant Director and Senior Scientific Officer (Sr. 1-5): Overall record and Interview.
  • For Junior Scientific Officer and Laboratory Assistant (Sr. 6-8): Merit in Written Test and/or Skill Test.
  • For all Non-Academic Posts: Merit in Written Test and/or Skill Test.
  • Screening test may be conducted to shortlist candidates.
  • Document verification required; no TA/DA for tests/interviews.

✅ Probation: 2 years for selected candidates.

How to Apply for NFSU Recruitment 2026

Follow these steps to apply online:

  1. Visit the NFSU Samarth Portal: https://nfsunt.samarth.edu.in.
  2. Register and select the relevant advertisement/post.
  3. Fill the online application form with accurate details.
  4. Upload required documents:
    • Educational certificates/marksheets
    • Experience certificates
    • Category certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD)
    • ID proof, photo, signature
    • Change of name documents (if applicable)
  5. Pay application fee (Rs. 500 + GST for Gen/EWS/OBC; exempted for SC/ST/PwBD/Women).
  6. Verify details and submit.
  7. Download confirmation for reference.

Important Notes:

  • Separate applications/fees for multiple posts.
  • Applications must be complete; no changes after submission.
  • Check email/Samarth dashboard/website for updates.

Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test for Working Teachers 2026 is a special TET conducted by the Tamil Nadu Teachers Recruitment Board (TRB) to help in-service teachers qualify the mandatory eligibility test for teaching Classes 1 to 8.

The Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test (TNTET) is a state-level examination that assesses the eligibility of candidates to teach in primary and upper primary schools. The 2026 edition is special as it focuses exclusively on working teachers, providing them an opportunity to clear the test amid government directives making TET mandatory for promotions and continued service. This is particularly relevant following recent G.O.s and court rulings emphasizing TET qualification for in-service educators. Working teachers in government, aided, and recognized private schools should read this article to understand application details, preparation strategies, and benefits.

Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test for Working Teachers 2026 – Complete Guide

The Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test for Working Teachers 2026 is designed to certify the eligibility of in-service teachers for teaching positions in Classes 1 to 8. Conducted by the Teachers Recruitment Board (TRB) under the Government of Tamil Nadu, it targets working teachers appointed before a specified cutoff date. The exam is held in offline mode using OMR sheets, with two separate papers: Paper 1 for Classes 1–5 and Paper 2 for Classes 6–8.

What is Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test for Working Teachers 2026?

TET is a state-level eligibility test for teachers of Classes 1–8 in government and aided schools, ensuring they meet national standards for teaching aptitude and subject knowledge. The 2026 version includes a special focus on working teachers who have not yet cleared TET, aligning with government and Supreme Court directives to make it mandatory for all educators. Clearing TET is now essential for job security and career advancement in Tamil Nadu.

  • Conducting body: Teachers Recruitment Board (TRB), Government of Tamil Nadu
  • Level: State-level eligibility test
  • Applicable classes: Paper 1 – Classes 1–5, Paper 2 – Classes 6–8

Eligibility Criteria for Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test 2026 (Working Teachers)

Eligibility is limited to working teachers appointed on or before 01.09.2025 as Secondary Grade Teachers (SGT), BT Assistants, or equivalent cadres on time scale, consolidated, or part-time pay in specified departments and schools.

Educational Qualification for Paper 1 (Classes 1–5)

Candidates must possess the qualifications as per G.O.(Ms).No.13, School Education [SE3(1)] Department, dated 30.01.2020, including 10+2/HSC plus Diploma in Teacher Education/Diploma in Elementary Education or equivalent. This applies to Secondary Grade Teachers, BRTEs, and Special Education Teachers (IEDSS). In-service teachers in aided or unaided schools are also eligible if they meet NCTE norms.

Educational Qualification for Paper 2 (Classes 6–8)

Graduation in the relevant subject plus B.Ed. or equivalent, as per special rules for Tamil Nadu School Educational Subordinate Services. For Special Education Teachers, qualifications from G.O.(Ms).No.144, dated 17.06.2025 apply. Subject-specific requirements include relevant graduation for Mathematics/Science or Social Science teachers.

Age Limit and In-Service Relaxations

There is no upper age limit specified for TET eligibility. Relaxations in qualifying marks apply: 50% for BC/BCM/MBC/DNC/PWD and 40% for SC/SCA/ST.

Who Can Apply as a Working Teacher?

In-service teachers in government, government-aided, and recognized unaided private schools teaching Classes 1 to 8, including those under various departments like School Education, MBC, ADW, Tribal Welfare, and corporations. Qualified serving teachers opting for promotion must also apply.

TN TET 2026 Exam Pattern for Working Teachers

The exam pattern is identical for working and non-working candidates: 150 MCQs, 3 hours duration, no negative marking.

Tamil Nadu TET 2026 Syllabus for Working Teachers

The syllabus is based on the state-prescribed topics for Classes 1–8, with difficulty up to secondary/higher secondary stage.

TNTET 2026 Paper 1 Syllabus (Classes 1–5)

  • Child Development and Pedagogy: Stages of child development, learning theories, inclusive education, teaching–learning process, assessment and evaluation.
  • Language I (regional language): Reading comprehension, grammar, language skills, pedagogy of language development.
  • Language II – English: Comprehension, vocabulary, grammar, communication, English language pedagogy.
  • Mathematics: Number system, operations, fractions, decimals, geometry, measurement, data handling, pedagogy of mathematics.
  • Environmental Studies: Family and friends, food, water, travel, shelter, environment, resources, EVS pedagogy.

TNTET 2026 Paper 2 Syllabus (Classes 6–8)

  • Child Development and Pedagogy (11–14): Adolescent development, learning and motivation, classroom management, evaluation.
  • Language I and II: Similar components as Paper 1 but at higher difficulty level.
  • Subject-specific: Mathematics & Science – algebra, geometry, mensuration, statistics, basics of physics, chemistry, biology, pedagogy. Social Science – history, geography, civics, economics, social science pedagogy.

Note that the official TRB syllabus PDF must be followed strictly.

Application Process for Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test 2026 (Working Teachers)

Applications are online only via http://www.trb.tn.gov.in. Separate applications for Paper 1 and Paper 2 with fees.

  • Register with valid email and mobile number.
  • Fill details, upload photo (40-60 KB, JPG/JPEG/PNG), signature (20-40 KB), and certificates (250-300 KB PDF).
  • Pay fee: Rs.600/- (general) or Rs.300/- (SC/SCA/ST/PWD) via net banking/credit/debit card.
  • Use edit window if needed; submit by 10-04-2026.

Documents required:

  • 10th/SSLC, 12th/HSC, Diploma/B.Ed./UG certificates and mark sheets.
  • Community certificate, Differently Abled certificate.
  • Service Certificate (Annexure-I).

Exam Centres, Hall Ticket and Exam Day Guidelines

Exams in all districts; centre details in hall ticket. Download hall ticket from TRB website. Report early with ID proof; no electronic gadgets allowed. OMR-based; follow invigilator instructions.

TN TET 2026 Result, Certificate Validity and Use for Promotions

Results published on http://www.trb.tn.gov.in as qualified lists. Qualifying candidates receive TNTET certificates. Validity is lifetime as per norms. For working teachers, TET clearance is mandatory for promotions in Tamil Nadu government schools; it's an eligibility criterion for career progression.

Benefits of Clearing Tamil Nadu TET 2026 for Working Teachers

  • Eligibility for regularization and promotions in government and aided schools.
  • Compliance with Supreme Court directions making TET mandatory for Classes 1–8 teachers.
  • Better job security and mobility, eligibility for future recruitment drives.
  • Professional recognition and alignment with national teacher quality standards.

Preparation Strategy for Working Teachers – How to Crack TN TET 2026

Balance school duties with study by focusing on pedagogy sections. Use NCERT/Tamil Nadu textbooks for content revision.

  • Create a weekly timetable around school hours.
  • Revise core concepts from textbook levels you teach daily.
  • Use weekends for full-length mock tests.
  • Focus on weak sections identified from previous attempts.

Eligibility Criteria

Immediate Absorption Basis: This recruitment is only for candidates currently working in Central Government / State Government / PSU / Other Government organizations on regular basis.

1. Senior Manager (Finance & Accounts) - E-4 Grade

Essential Qualification: Graduate with CA (Chartered Accountant) from ICAI or CMA (Cost Management Accountant) from ICMAI with valid membership.

Experience: Minimum 8 years post-qualification experience AND currently working in IDA pay scale ₹70,000-2,00,000 / Pay Matrix Level 11 (7th CPC) or above, OR minimum 2 years experience in lower IDA pay scale ₹60,000-1,80,000 / Pay Matrix Level 10 (7th CPC).

2. Manager (Finance & Accounts) - E-3 Grade (2 Posts)

Essential Qualification: Graduate with CA (Chartered Accountant) from ICAI or CMA (Cost Management Accountant) from ICMAI with valid membership.

Experience: Minimum 5 years post-qualification experience AND currently working in IDA pay scale ₹60,000-1,80,000 / Pay Matrix Level 10 (7th CPC) or above, OR minimum 2 years experience in lower IDA pay scale ₹50,000-1,60,000 / Pay Matrix Level 9 (7th CPC).

Age Limit: Maximum 37 years as on 12-03-2026

3. Manager (Finance & Accounts/Compliance) - E-3 Grade (1 Post)

Essential Qualification: Graduate with CS (Company Secretary) from ICSI (Institute of Company Secretaries of India) with valid membership.

Experience: Minimum 5 years post-qualification experience AND currently working in IDA pay scale ₹60,000-1,80,000 / Pay Matrix Level 10 (7th CPC) or above, OR minimum 2 years experience in lower IDA pay scale ₹50,000-1,60,000 / Pay Matrix Level 9 (7th CPC).

Age Limit: Maximum 37 years as on 12-03-2026

4. Junior Officer (Finance & Accounts) - S-2 Grade (1 Post)

Essential Qualification: Graduate with CA Intermediate from ICAI or CMA Intermediate from ICMAI.

Experience: Minimum 5 years post-qualification experience AND currently working in IDA pay scale ₹44,000-1,53,000 / Pay Matrix Level 7 (7th CPC) or above, OR minimum 2 years experience in lower IDA pay scale ₹40,000-1,36,000 / Pay Matrix Level 6 (7th CPC).

Age Limit: Maximum 37 years as on 12-03-2026

Important Notes:

  • Post/pay-scale held on temporary, contract, adhoc, deputation, non-functional upgradation, or MACP financial upgradation basis shall not be considered for eligibility.
  • All qualifications must be recognized by Government of India.
  • All qualifications must be from Universities/Institutions recognized by AICTE/UGC/appropriate statutory authority of Government of India.
  • Candidates on deputation to other organizations must satisfy eligibility conditions based on parent organization.
  • The cutoff date for age, experience, and qualification is 12-03-2026.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 10-02-2026
Application Process Opens 10-02-2026

Selection Process

The selection process for CONCOR Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following:

  1. Shortlisting: Only candidates fulfilling all eligibility criteria will be shortlisted. In case of large number of eligible applicants, CONCOR reserves the right to shortlist limited candidates based on relevant qualifications, additional professional qualifications, experience, and achievements.
  2. Interview/Power Point Presentation (PPT): Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview and/or power point presentation.
  3. Performance Assessment: Assessment based on APARs (Annual Performance Appraisal Reports) for the preceding three years.
  4. Weightage Criteria: Weightage will be given to APAR ratings, experience profile, additional professional qualifications, and personality traits as per extant policy.
  5. Reservation: Reservation rules are NOT applicable for immediate absorption recruitment.
  6. Communication: Names of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on www.concorindia.co.in. Email notifications will be sent to shortlisted candidates.

Important: CONCOR reserves the right to modify or amend any part of the selection process at any stage before the interview.

Salary/Stipend

The selected candidates will be offered competitive compensation packages as per the following pay scales:

Post Grade Pay Scale (IDA) Basic + DA
Senior Manager (Finance & Accounts) E-4 ₹70,000 - ₹2,00,000 As per IDA pay pattern

Additional Benefits: The company offers an attractive compensation package including:

  • Leased accommodation or HRA
  • Perks & Allowances under cafeteria approach
  • Performance-related pay
  • Medical facilities and group insurance
  • Pension and CPF benefits
  • Post-retirement medical benefits
  • Gratuity as per extant policies

How to Apply

Application Process: This is an offline recruitment on immediate absorption basis. Applications must be submitted through the proper channel of the candidate's parent organization.

Step-by-Step Application Process:

  1. Visit CONCOR website: www.concorindia.co.in
  2. Go to HR & Career → Recruitment Notices & Results section
  3. Download the application form (Vacancy Notice No. 01/2026)
  4. Read the detailed vacancy advertisement carefully
  5. Fill the application form in English language in block letters
  6. Ensure the application is properly signed
  7. Prepare required documents and certificates (as mentioned below)
  8. Submit through Proper Channel: Submit the completed application to your parent organization's HR department requesting them to forward the application along with:
    • No Objection Certificate (NOC)
    • Department & Action Record (D&AR)
    • Vigilance Clearance
    • APARs for preceding 3 years
    • Guidelines on APAR rating criteria (if different from APARs)
  9. Mailing Address: The parent organization should forward the complete application to:
    Sr. General Manager (Human Resources)
    Container Corporation of India Limited (CONCOR)
    3rd Floor, NSIC Business Park Building
    Okhla Industrial Estate, New Delhi - 110020
  10. The envelope should be superscribed: "Application for the post of _________________ under Sr. No. ______ on Immediate Absorption Basis"
  11. One envelope should contain only one application
  12. Candidates can apply for only ONE post (not multiple)
  13. Submit before 12-03-2026

Important Notes:

Application Fee

  • Application Fee: ₹100/- (One Hundred only).
  • Exempted Categories: Women candidates and candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, PwBD (Person with Benchmark Disability) & Ex-Servicemen category are exempted from paying application fees.
  • Note: Ex-Servicemen who have already secured employment in civil post under Central Government / Government of NCT of Delhi or its Autonomous / Local Bodies on regular basis after availing of the benefits of reservation given to Ex-Servicemen for their re-employment are NOT eligible for fees concession.
  • Payment Mode: Online payment through SBI e-Pay only. No other mode of payment shall be accepted/considered and payment made shall stand forfeited.
  • Application fees once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification / Advertisement Date 25/02/2026
Opening Date for Submission of Online Applications 27th February 2026 (From 12.00 Noon)
Closing Date for Submission of Online Applications 28th March 2026 (Till 11:59 PM)
Crucial Date / Cut-Off Date for Eligibility 28/03/2026
Date of Examination To be intimated in due course through the website of the Board

Selection Process

  • The selection shall be made through examination schemes as specified below:
    • One Tier (General) – Post Code 17/26: One Tier exam (I-T-G) of 2 hours duration. Total 200 MCQ questions of 200 marks. Syllabus: General Awareness, General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability, Arithmetical & Numerical Ability, Test of Hindi Language & Comprehension, Test of English Language & Comprehension (40 marks each). Final merit will be prepared on the basis of marks secured in the written examination.
    • One Tier (Technical) – Post Codes 07/26, 08/26, 09/26, 10/26, 11/26, 13/26, 14/26, 16/26, 18/26, 19/26, 20/26: One Tier exam (I-T-T) of 2 hours duration. Total 200 MCQ questions of 200 marks. Section-A: General Awareness, General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability, Arithmetical & Numerical Ability, Test of Hindi Language & Comprehension, Test of English Language & Comprehension (20 marks each; 100 questions: 100 marks). Section-B: Objective type MCQs on the subject concerned as per the qualification prescribed for the post (100 questions: 100 marks). Mandatory minimum qualifying marks applicable only in domain subject specific Section-B, not in Section-A. Combined marks of both sections reckoned for final merit list.
    • Two Tier (General) – Post Code 12/26: Two-tier exam (II-T-G). Tier-I (2 hours): 200 MCQ questions of 200 marks (qualifying in nature). Tier-II (3 hours, one session): Part-I MCQ (200 questions: 200 marks) + Part-II Descriptive (75 marks) = Grand Total 275. Part-II: Essay in English (50 marks) + Letter writing/Expansion of ideas in English (25 marks). Selection based on cumulative marks obtained in Part-I & Part-II of Tier-II.
    • Two Tier (Technical-2) – Post Codes 01/26, 02/26, 03/26, 04/26, 05/26, 06/26, 15/26: Two-tier exam (II-T-T2). Tier-I (2 hours): Section-A (100 questions: 100 marks, general) + Section-B (100 questions: 100 marks, subject-related) = 200 marks (qualifying in nature). Tier-II (3 hours, one session): Part-I MCQ (200 questions: 200 marks, subject-related) + Part-II Descriptive (50 marks) = Grand Total 250. Part-II: Essay in English (30 marks) + Letter writing/Expansion of ideas in English (20 marks). In Tier-II, mandatory minimum qualifying marks applicable in domain subject specific Part-I; combined marks of both parts reckoned for final merit list.
  • Marks scored by candidates in the Computer Based Test/Exam will be normalized (if required) using the formula published by DSSSB vide Notice No. 10(271)/Sec.Cell/DSSSB/18/989 dated 11.07.2018.
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: General/EWS: 40%; OBC (Delhi): 35%; SC/ST/PH (PwBD): 30%. Ex-Servicemen will be given 5% relaxation in their respective categories, subject to a minimum of 30%.
  • Negative Marking: Deduction of 0.25 marks for each wrong MCQ answer of 01 mark.
  • Skill Test / Physical Endurance Test / Driving Test / Trade Test etc. will be taken as per requirement of the job.
  • Draft answer keys of the Computer Based Examination will be displayed on the DSSSB website after the examination. Candidates may submit online objections within the stipulated time limit.

How to Apply

  • Before submitting online applications, the candidate must ensure that he/she is registered on DSSSB's portal i.e. https://dsssbonline.nic.in. Registration with DSSSB is a one-time exercise.
  • Eligible candidates may apply online through the website https://dsssbonline.nic.in from 27th February 2026 (12.00 Noon) up to 28th March 2026 (till 11:59 PM), thereafter the link will be disabled.
  • Candidates must go through the instructions carefully while filling up the online application form for the post concerned.
  • Candidates must submit their application through Online Mode only. No other mode of application shall be accepted. Applications received through any other mode i.e. by post / by hand / by mail etc. will not be accepted.
  • Pay the application fee of ₹100/- through SBI e-Pay only. No other mode of payment shall be accepted.
  • Before submission of the online application, candidates must check and ensure that they have filled correct details. Once the online application form is submitted, no request for change/correction/modification (including change of category) shall be entertained.
  • Candidates are advised to submit the online application much before the closing date and not to wait till the last date.
  • If an applicant submits multiple registrations and appears in the examination more than once, his/her candidature will be cancelled and he/she will be debarred from the examinations of the Board.
  • Candidates are advised to upload a recent and clear colour photograph. The background should be plain white or off-white, with full face, front view, eyes open.
  • Candidates must fill their correct and active e-mail addresses and mobile numbers in the online application form.
  • After successful submission, candidates should take a printout of the online application form for their own records.

IDBI Bank JAM Grade O Eligibility Criteria 2026

Nationality / Citizenship

Candidate must be: a citizen of India OR a subject of Nepal/Bhutan OR a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 01 January 1962 OR a person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries, subject to a Government of India eligibility certificate where applicable.​

Educational Qualification (as on 01 March 2026)

  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a University recognized/approved by Government / Govt. bodies (AICTE, UGC, etc.).​

  • Minimum 60% marks for General/EWS/OBC and 55% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates.​

  • Only a diploma is not acceptable; candidates must possess a full degree.​

  • Candidate must have valid semester-wise or consolidated mark sheets and degree/provisional degree certificate dated on or before 01 March 2026.​

  • Candidates are expected to have proficiency in computers/IT.​

Age Limit 2026 (as on 01 March 2026)

  • Minimum age: 20 years.​

  • Maximum age: 25 years.​

  • Candidate must have been born not earlier than 02 March 2001 and not later than 01 March 2006 (both dates inclusive).​

Age Relaxation 2026

  • SC/ST: up to 5 years.​

  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): up to 3 years.​

  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): up to 10 years.​

  • Ex-Servicemen / ECOs / SSCOs with at least 5 years military service and released on eligible terms: up to 5 years.​

  • Persons affected by 1984 riots: up to 5 years.​

Language Proficiency & Domicile

  • Candidate must be proficient (reading, writing and understanding) in at least one of the languages specified for the chosen zone.​

  • Candidate must furnish a valid self-domicile certificate for the state of the applied zone or Class X/XII mark sheet/certificate showing knowledge of the indicated language.

 Age Limit

  • Minimum Age Limit: 20 Years
  • Maximum Age limit: 25 Years
  • Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

IDBI Bank JAM Grade O Salary 2026

  • On joining as Grade “O”, the compensation on Cost to Company (CTC) basis is expected to range between ₹6.14 lakh to ₹6.50 lakh per annum (for Class A cities) at the time of joining.
  • Selected candidates will be covered under IDBI Bank Ltd. New Pension Scheme (IBLNPS) rules, 2011, as amended from time to time.
  • Career progression: Grade “O” officers may be considered for promotion to Grade “A” after completion of 3 years of service, subject to performance, vacancies and applicable promotion policy.

Physical Standards Tests / Physical Efficiency Tests After declaration of Written Exam result
Interview / Personality Test After PST/PET (for qualified candidates)
Medical Standards Tests After Interview / Personality Test

Selection Process

  • Stage 1: Written Examination (19th July, 2026)
    • Paper-I: General Ability and Intelligence - 250 Marks
      • Duration: 2 hours (10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon)
      • Type: Objective (Multiple Choice) Type questions
      • Medium: English as well as Hindi
      • Subjects: General Mental Ability (logical reasoning, quantitative aptitude, numerical ability, data interpretation), General Science, Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Polity & Economy, History of India, Indian & World Geography
      • There will be penalty (Negative Marking) for wrong answers: One third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for each wrong answer
    • Paper-II: General Studies, Essay and Comprehension - 200 Marks
      • Duration: 3 hours (2:00 PM to 5:00 PM)
      • Type: Conventional (Descriptive) Type
      • Part-A: Essay questions (80 Marks) - to be answered in long narrative form either in Hindi or English. Topics: modern Indian history especially freedom struggle, geography, polity and economy, security and human rights issues, analytical ability
      • Part-B: Comprehension, précis writing, other communications/language skills (120 Marks) - to be attempted in English only. Topics: Comprehension passages, précis writing, developing counter arguments, simple grammar and other language testing aspects
      • Candidates must write answers only in the medium allowed. No credit for answers written in other medium
    • There will be minimum qualifying marks separately in each Paper as may be fixed by the Commission
    • Paper-I will be evaluated first and Paper-II will be evaluated only for those who obtain minimum qualifying marks in Paper-I
  • Stage 2: Physical Standards Tests (PST) / Physical Efficiency Tests (PET)
    • Conducted for candidates qualified in Written Examination
    • Physical Standards Requirements:
      • Men: Height 165 cm, Chest 81 cm (unexpanded) with 5 cm minimum expansion, Weight 50 kg
      • Women: Height 157 cm, Weight 46 kg
      • Height and chest measurement will be measured correct to one decimal in centimeter
      • Weight should be as per height and age as per prescribed chart
    • Physical Efficiency Tests:
      • Men: 100 Meter Race in 16 Seconds, 800 Meter Race in 3 Min 45 Sec, Long Jump 3.5 Meters (3 Chances), Shot Put (7.26 Kg) 4.5 Meters (3 Chances)
      • Women: 100 Meter Race in 18 Seconds, 800 Meter Race in 4 Min 45 Sec, Long Jump 3.0 Meters (3 Chances)
    • Female candidates must submit self-declaration about pregnancy status before PST/PET
    • Conducted under supervision of Nodal Authority appointed by Ministry of Home Affairs
  • Stage 3: Interview / Personality Test
    • Only for candidates qualified in PST/PET
    • Marks: 150 Marks
    • Conducted by Union Public Service Commission
    • Candidates declared unqualified in PET will not be called for Interview
    • NCC 'B' or 'C' Certificate holders will be given consideration at Interview stage
  • Stage 4: Medical Standards Tests (MST)
    • Conducted only for candidates who appeared in Interview/Personality Test
    • Detailed Medical Standards prescribed for Eye Sight, Ear, Nose, Neck, Teeth, General Health, etc.
    • Eye Sight: Better eye 6/6 or 6/9 (corrected), Worse eye 6/12 or 6/9 (corrected), Near Vision N6/N9 (corrected), Colour Perception CP-III by ISIHARA plates
    • LASIK surgery correction permitted subject to prescribed criteria
    • Candidates declared 'UNFIT' can appear before Review Medical Board preferably next day of DME
    • Appeals against MST results must be made within 24 hours after declaration of DME results
    • Conducted under supervision of Nodal Authority appointed by Ministry of Home Affairs
  • Final Selection/Merit:
    • Merit list drawn on basis of marks obtained in Written Examination and Interview/Personality Test
    • Any candidate found not satisfying prescribed Medical Standards after MST will not be appointed
    • Tie Breaking Principle: (i) Higher marks in written total, (ii) Higher marks in Paper-I, (iii) Senior in age, (iv) At Commission's discretion

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply online only using the Commission's website: https://upsconline.nic.in
  • No other mode is allowed for submission of application
  • Application Process has Four Modules:
    • Module 1: Account Creation - Can be filled anytime (common for all exams)
    • Module 2: Universal Registration (URN) - Can be filled anytime (common for all exams). URN generated is unique and remains constant for all UPSC exams
    • Module 3: Common Application Form (CAF) - Can be filled anytime (common for all exams)
    • Module 4: Examination Specific Module - Can be filled only during notification period (includes fees, centres, force preferences, etc.)
  • Documents Required:
    • Recent passport-size colour photograph (scanned in .jpg format, 20 KB to 200 KB)
    • Signature (scanned - sign three times one below other on plain white paper using black ink, .jpg format, 20 KB to 100 KB)
    • Live photograph (to be captured while filling CAF)
    • One Photo ID Card details (Aadhaar/Voter/PAN/Passport/Driving License/Any other Government Photo ID)
    • Date of Birth certificate (Matriculation/Secondary School Leaving Certificate)
    • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
    • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) in prescribed format, if applicable
    • OBC candidates: OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate based on income for FY 2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23, issued on/after 01.04.2025 but not later than 12.03.2026
    • EWS candidates: EWS Certificate based on income for FY 2024-25, issued on/after 01.04.2025 but not later than 12.03.2026
    • Ex-servicemen: Prescribed Certificate and Undertaking as per Appendix-VI(A) and VI(B)
  • Read General Instructions, Profile/Module-wise Instructions, and Instructions for uploading documents carefully before filling the form
  • Prepare requisite documents in advance for smooth flow during form filling
  • Pay application fee (if applicable) through Net Banking/Credit/Debit Card/UPI
  • Select examination centre from available options (first-apply-first-allot basis)
  • Indicate force preferences (BSF/CRPF/CISF/ITBP/SSB)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Online applications are invited from unmarried male candidates for enrolment as sailors in Medical Branch for SSR (Med) in 02/2027 batch.
  • Candidates must satisfy eligibility conditions as laid down by the Government of India for enrolment as sailors in the Indian Navy.
  • Candidates must have qualified in 10+2 examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology (PCB) from Boards of School Education recognised by Ministry of Education, Government of India.
  • Passed Matriculation from any recognised board
  • Candidates must have scored at least 50% marks in aggregate and a minimum of 40% in each subject (Physics, Chemistry and Biology) in the 10+2 examination.
  • Candidates who are appearing in class 12th Board Exam of academic year 2025-26 are also eligible to apply, provided they fulfil all other eligibility criteria.
  • Such appearing candidates will be selected only when they produce the original marksheet during subsequent stages of recruitment and secure the minimum prescribed marks in aggregate as well as in individual subjects.
  • Candidates must be born between 01 May 2005 and 31 October 2009 (both dates inclusive) to be eligible for SSR (MED) 02/2027 batch.
  • Candidates born between 01 May 2005 and 31 October 2009 are also eligible to apply for INET 2026 and will be considered for Stage II recruitment of the respective batch as per age criteria.
  • Candidates must be in good physical and mental health, free from any disease or disability likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties at sea and ashore in peace as well as war conditions.
  • Minimum height standard for male candidates is 157 cm, with height relaxations regulated as per Government orders; detailed regulations are available on the official website.
  • Visual standards required are uncorrected vision 6/12, 6/12 and corrected vision 6/6, 6/6 with colour perception CP Pass.
  • Permanent body tattoos are only permitted on inner face of forearms (from inside of elbow to the wrist) and on the reverse side of palm/back (dorsal) side of hand; permanent tattoos on any other part of the body are not acceptable and will lead to bar from recruitment.
  • Insurance cover (on contribution) of Rs. 75 lakhs is applicable for sailors.
  • Candidates must meet medical standards as assessed by authorised military doctors during Recruitment Medical Examination and Pre-Enrolment Medicals at INS Chilka.

  • Promotion prospects exist up to the rank of Master Chief Petty Officer-I, corresponding to Level 8 of the Defence Pay Matrix (Rs. 47,600 – Rs. 1,51,100) plus MSP Rs. 5,200/- per month plus DA as applicable.
  • During training and service, sailors are provided books, reading material, uniforms, food and accommodation as per entitlement.
  • Sailors are entitled to medical treatment, Leave Travel Concession for self and dependents, Group Housing benefits, Annual and Casual leave, Children Education and House Rent Allowances, and post-retirement benefits including pension, gratuity and leave encashment as per service conditions and Government orders.

 Age Limit (as on 01-05-2005 to 31-10-2009)

  • Candidates should be born between 01 May 2005 and 31 October 2009 (both dates inclusive).
  • Candidates born within these dates are eligible to apply for Stage I – INET 2026 and will be considered for Stage II of SSR (MED) 02/2027 batch as per stated age criteria.
  • Only unmarried male candidates meeting the age range are eligible for enrolment as sailors in SSR (Med) 02/2027 batch.

Application Fee

  • An examination fee of Rs. 550/- (Rupees Five hundred fifty only) plus 18% GST is to be paid by candidates during Stage I – INET application.
  • The fee must be paid in online mode using net banking, Visa/Master/RuPay Credit/Debit Card or UPI.
  • Admit card will be issued only to candidates who have successfully paid the examination fee.
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, nor can it be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.
  • Candidates found to have registered multiple times will be rejected and debarred from the examination, and reimbursement of exam fee will not be carried out in such cases.
  • In case of unsuccessful payment where money has been deducted without admit card generation, candidates are advised to wait for 7 working days for automatic refund to their account.
  • Fee will be charged only during Stage I – INET application, and there will be no separate fee for Stage II process.

Selection Process

  • The selection process consists of Stage I – INET (Indian Navy Entrance Test) followed by Stage II (Physical Fitness Test, Written Examination and Recruitment Medical) and Pre-Enrolment Medicals.
  • Stage I – INET is a computer-based examination with 100 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions, each carrying 1 mark.
  • The Stage I question paper is bilingual (Hindi & English) and comprises four sections: English, Science, Biology and General Awareness.
  • The standard of Stage I question paper is that of 10+2, and syllabus and sample papers are available on the official website.
  • The duration of Stage I examination is one hour, and candidates are required to pass in all sections as well as in aggregate; pass marks in each section and aggregate are determined by the Indian Navy.
  • Negative marking is applicable in Stage I – one fourth (0.25) marks will be deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Centre allocation for INET (online examination) is at the discretion of the Indian Navy.
  • In case of extraneous circumstances causing non-conduct of INET or as per service requirement, Indian Navy reserves the right to shortlist candidates based on marks obtained in qualifying examinations (10th/12th board exams).
  • Results of Stage I – INET (Pass/Fail) along with marks scored will be uploaded on the candidate’s online dashboard.
  • Candidates eligible for Stage II as per age criteria will be shortlisted for SSR (Medical) 02/2027 batch based on marks obtained in Stage I – INET 2026.
  • Shortlisting for Stage II will be carried out state wise, and cut-off marks for next stage will vary from state to state as vacancies are allotted state-wise.
  • If candidates with the same percentage exceed required numbers, shortlisting will be done based on Date of Birth, with earlier DOB (fewer chances) given priority.
  • Sponsor candidates and NCC ‘C’ certificate holders who upload original sponsor and NCC certificates during Stage I application and whose certificates are verified will be exempted from Stage I – INET and will be directly issued call-up for Stage II based on eligibility.
  • Stage II begins with Physical Fitness Test (PFT), which is mandatory; candidates undergoing PFT do so at their own risk.
  • PFT standards for male candidates are: 1.6 km run in 6 min 30 sec, 20 Squats (Uthak Baithak), 15 Push-ups and 15 Bent Knee Sit-ups.
  • The Stage II written exam is conducted only for candidates who qualify the PFT and consists of 100 objective-type questions of 1 mark each.
  • The Stage II written exam question paper is bilingual (Hindi & English) and comprises four sections: English, Science, Biology and General Awareness, with 10+2 level standard and one-hour duration.
  • Candidates must pass in all sections and in aggregate in the Stage II written exam; pass marks are set by the Indian Navy.
  • Recruitment Medical Examination is carried out for candidates who qualify PFT; candidates who qualify Recruitment Medical are considered for the merit list.
  • Candidates found medically unfit in Recruitment Medical may appeal for review at a designated military hospital within 5 days; medical certificates from other hospitals are not accepted and no further review/appeal is permissible.
  • Provisional Select List is prepared based on performance in Stage II written exam, subject to qualification in PFT and Recruitment Medical; merit list for SSR (Medical) is state-wise and cut-off for call-up to INS Chilka varies by state.
  • Pre-Enrolment Medical formalities are conducted at INS Chilka and induction is subject to qualifying these formalities; candidates not qualifying pre-enrolment medicals will be rejected.

How to Apply

  • Candidates can apply online for Stage I – INET 2026 for SSR (MED) 02/2027 batch only through the website https://joinindiannavy.gov.in from 14 March 2026 (00:01 hrs) to 06 April 2026 (17:00 hrs).
  • Candidates must register and fill the online application with accurate personal, educational and contact details as per instructions on the portal.
  • All required original documents (certificates, mark sheets, domicile certificate, NCC certificate if held) must be scanned and uploaded as per the specifications given in the online application.
  • Candidates must upload the prescribed photograph as specified, and also capture a good quality live photograph through webcam during application.
  • Examination fee payment of Rs. 550/- plus 18% GST must be made online using net banking, credit/debit card or UPI during application; admit card will be generated only after successful fee payment.
  • Candidates may optionally use Common Service Centres (CSC) for uploading application for a service fee of Rs. 60 + GST.
  • After submission, candidates should regularly check their online dashboard on the recruitment website for updates, admit card download, results and call-up letters.
  • Candidates must download call-up letters cum admit cards for Stage I – INET and later stages from the website; no call-up letters will be sent by post.
  • Candidates must report to the examination centre as per reporting time mentioned in call-up letter; late reporting (30 minutes after reporting time) will not be permitted.
  • Selected candidates must carry all original documents and self-attested copies to recruitment stages including INS Chilka for verification; any discrepancy with online details will result in cancellation of candidature.

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications

  • Status: Must be a Government servant (current or former) OR has held any post under the Government of India/State Government/Union Territory
  • Educational Qualification: Must possess:
    • Law degree (LL.B. from a recognized university), OR
    • Be well-experienced in relation to legal affairs to the satisfaction of the High Court
  • Professional Background: Experience in legal matters, judicial work, or administrative/legal roles under Government is an advantage

Term & Age

  • Term of Office: 4 years from the date of assumption of charge OR attaining the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier
  • Age Limit: No specific upper age limit mentioned, but term ends at age 70
  • Transferability: A candidate appointed for a specific district shall NOT be transferred to any other district under any circumstances

Previous SJM/SMM Experience

  • Ex-SJMs appointed by Government of Uttar Pradesh do NOT need to submit character roll entries
  • Ex-SJMs applying for re-appointment must enclose four best judgments delivered while holding the post of SJM/SMM

Selection Process Merit-based by High Court

Selection Process

  • Application Scrutiny: All applications are submitted to the respective District Judge who conducts preliminary scrutiny
  • District Judge Review: The District Judge reviews applications and forwards only those he finds fit for the SJM post to the High Court with his remarks
  • High Court Evaluation: The High Court evaluates forwarded applications based on qualifications, experience, and legal expertise
  • Merit-Based Selection: Selection is based on merit, qualifications, Government service record, and experience in legal matters
  • Final Appointment: Appointment is made by the High Court through formal order of the Court

Salary/Remuneration

  • Fixed Honorarium: ₹45,000/- per month (fixed, subject to correction and updation by High Court)
  • Conveyance Allowance: ₹5,000/- per month for official travel and conveyance
  • Total Monthly Remuneration: ₹50,000/- per month (base honorarium + conveyance)
  • Payment: Subject to correction and updation from time to time as per High Court guidelines

How to Apply

Application Preparation

  1. Download the Application Form from the official High Court notification PDF
  2. Fill all columns of the application form in block letters (all columns are compulsory)
  3. Affix a self-attested recent passport-size photograph
  4. Provide complete and accurate information including:
    • Full name, father's name, date of birth
    • Current and permanent residential addresses with PIN codes
    • Email address and mobile number
    • Details of posts held under the Government (designation, pay scale, duration, retirement date)
    • Educational qualifications (High School, Intermediate, Graduation, LL.B., and any other qualifications)
    • Whether previously worked as SJM/SMM with year-wise details and annual confidential report percentages
  5. Mention whether any criminal case is pending or FIR lodged
  6. Sign the declaration that all information provided is correct

Required Documents (Self-Attested)

  • Photocopies of all relevant documents mentioned in the application
  • Character roll entries of the last 5 years of Government service (if applicable)
  • Law degree certificate and other educational qualification certificates
  • Copy of Gazette notification of Government service record
  • For ex-SJMs applying for re-appointment: Four best judgments delivered as SJM/SMM
  • Annual Confidential Reports (ACR) for the last 5 years (if available)
  • Self-attested photograph (4x6 cm)

Submission Mode

  1. Applicants must submit their applications OFFLINE directly to the respective District Judge of the district for which they are applying
  2. Do NOT send applications directly to the High Court — applications sent directly to High Court will be rejected
  3. Submit to the following District Judges based on your choice:
    • For Gonda: District Judge, Gonda District Court
    • For Jalaun: District Judge, Jalaun District Court
  4. Ensure all documents are complete and properly organized
  5. Keep a copy of submitted application for reference
